items.title_en: Too Smart for Its Own Good? Cognitive Fidelity and Competence Leakage in LLM Simulations of Young Learners
items.title_zh: 聪明反被聪明误？LLM 模拟年轻学习者中的认知保真度与能力泄漏
items.abstract_en: LLM-based interactive learner simulators are increasingly used in educational applications, including teacher training and tutoring system development. A critical requirement for those simulations is cognitive fidelity: the simulated learner should maintain the assigned knowledge, misconceptions, and reasoning procedures throughout interaction. However, LLMs may express knowledge or problem-solving skills beyond the assigned learner's cognitive status, a phenomenon we refer to as competence leakage. In this exploratory study, we examine 3,339 simulated learner utterances from 130 teacher-learner simulator transcripts across three learning scenarios and identify over-competence as a prominent direction of cognitive-profile misalignment during interaction. We then investigate the recurrence of previously observed competence leakage cases under four matched-trigger evaluation protocols, ranging from isolated questioning to multi-turn interactions, across five model configurations. Overall, we observe higher violation recurrence under multi-turn protocols than under isolated question answering. More capable models generally show lower recurrence, whereas increased reasoning effort does not consistently improve cognitive fidelity and is even associated with slightly higher recurrence under multi-turn protocols in our matched-model comparison. These findings provide exploratory evidence of competence leakage phenomena in interactive learner simulation and suggest that single-turn question-answering type of evaluations alone may be insufficient, motivating the development of more systematic and reliable multi-turn protocols for evaluating cognitive fidelity in learner simulation.
items.abstract_zh: 基于 LLM 的交互式学习者模拟器正越来越多地用于教育应用，包括教师培训和辅导系统开发。此类模拟的一项关键要求是认知保真度：被模拟的学习者应在整个交互过程中保持指定的知识、错误概念和推理过程。然而，LLM 可能表现出超出指定学习者认知状态的知识或问题解决技能，我们将这一现象称为能力泄漏。在这项探索性研究中，我们考察了来自 130 份教师-学习者模拟器记录、覆盖三个学习场景的 3,339 条模拟学习者话语，并将过度能力识别为交互过程中认知画像不匹配的一个突出方向。随后，我们在四种匹配触发评估协议下，从孤立提问到多轮交互，跨五种模型配置，研究先前观察到的能力泄漏案例的复现情况。总体而言，我们观察到多轮协议下的违规复现率高于孤立问答。能力更强的模型通常表现出更低的复现率，而增加推理努力并不能一致地提高认知保真度，并且在我们的匹配模型比较中，甚至与多轮协议下略高的复现率相关。这些发现为交互式学习者模拟中的能力泄漏现象提供了探索性证据，并表明仅靠单轮问答式评估可能不够，从而推动开发更系统、更可靠的多轮协议来评估学习者模拟中的认知保真度。

items.title_en: Toward Agentic Robotics: A Large-Scale Study of Harness Design for Robot-Use Agents
items.title_zh: 迈向智能体机器人：机器人使用智能体的框架设计大规模研究
items.abstract_en: Recent vision-language models (VLMs) can act as robot-use agents that understand diverse scenes and control robots through policy code and tools. However, they predict 3D gripper poses poorly even with extended reasoning, struggling with precise manipulation. Vision-language-action (VLA) and world-action (WAM) models are the opposite: they execute fast, smooth control on trained tasks, yet fail under domain shifts or when tasks require long-horizon memory and reasoning. Agentic robots therefore combine VLM reasoning and perception with precise VLA/WAM control through a policy harness. Yet harness design spans thousands of configurations, shifting success by tens of points with the same models. Moreover, testing even one design takes thousands of rollouts at high API and GPU cost, so prior works often commit to a single design chosen from few alternatives. To guide harness design, we evaluate over 470,000 rollouts across eight simulation benchmarks, six VLMs, and 15 VLA/WAM checkpoints. Seven controlled studies show effective harnesses must adapt to both VLM and VLA/WAM capabilities. Our findings specify what structure the VLM's policy code needs, where VLA manipulation needs help from tools and policy code, and when to involve the VLM at test time. The reference recipe X-Harness shows that these findings compose without weight updates, lifting base policies up to $+42.8$ points across memory, reasoning, and domain shifts.
items.abstract_zh: 近期的视觉-语言模型（VLM）可作为机器人使用智能体，理解多样场景并通过策略代码和工具控制机器人。然而，即使进行扩展推理，它们对 3D 夹爪位姿的预测仍很差，难以完成精确操作。视觉-语言-动作（VLA）和世界-动作（WAM）模型则相反：它们在训练任务上执行快速、平滑的控制，但在域偏移下或任务需要长时记忆与推理时失败。因此，智能体机器人通过策略执行框架将 VLM 的推理与感知和精确的 VLA/WAM 控制结合起来。然而，框架设计涵盖数千种配置，在相同模型下可使成功率相差数十分。此外，即使测试一种设计也需要数千次 rollout，API 和 GPU 成本高昂，因此先前工作通常从少量备选中选定一种设计。为指导框架设计，我们在八个模拟基准、六个 VLM 和 15 个 VLA/WAM 检查点上评估了超过 470,000 次 rollout。七项受控研究表明，有效的框架必须同时适应 VLM 和 VLA/WAM 的能力。我们的发现明确了 VLM 策略代码需要何种结构、VLA 操作在何处需要工具和策略代码的帮助，以及测试时何时需要引入 VLM。参考方案 X-Harness 表明，这些发现无需权重更新即可组合，在记忆、推理和域偏移方面将基础策略提升最多 +42.8 分。

items.title_en: Motion Beyond Pixels: Learning Future Visual Representations for Object-Centric Dynamics
items.title_zh: 超越像素的运动：面向以对象为中心的动力学学习未来视觉表征
items.abstract_en: Many embodied world models predict future states in latent spaces optimized for RGB reconstruction, which do not explicitly prioritize object-level semantics and geometry relevant to motion generation. We present MotionRep, a visual representation world model that jointly generates future DINO representations and 3D object flow, coupling semantic and geometric information with object-centric dynamics. To make high-dimensional DINO features amenable to generative modeling, we introduce DINO-VAE, which combines temporal and channel compression with latent regularization to produce compact latents while preserving semantic and geometric information. Conditioned on an initial observation, object query points, and a language instruction, a unified diffusion transformer predicts future visual representations and 3D object flow through joint attention. MotionRep employs asymmetric modality-specific noise schedules to keep the visual stream ahead of 3D object flow during joint denoising, allowing progressively refined future visual representations to guide flow generation. Experiments on simulated and real-world manipulation benchmarks demonstrate that MotionRep outperforms pixel-based baselines in 3D object flow accuracy and generalization to unseen scenes, while requiring only three denoising steps for inference. These results support predictive visual representations as an effective future-state space for object-centric dynamics modeling.
items.abstract_zh: 许多具身世界模型在针对 RGB 重建优化的潜空间中预测未来状态，这些空间并未明确优先考虑与运动生成相关的对象级语义和几何。我们提出 MotionRep，一种视觉表征世界模型，它联合生成未来的 DINO 表征和 3D 对象流，将以对象为中心的动力学与语义和几何信息耦合起来。为使高维 DINO 特征适用于生成建模，我们引入 DINO-VAE，它结合时间与通道压缩以及潜变量正则化，在保留语义和几何信息的同时产生紧凑的潜变量。以初始观测、对象查询点和语言指令为条件，一个统一的扩散 Transformer 通过联合注意力预测未来视觉表征和 3D 对象流。MotionRep 采用非对称的模态特定噪声调度，在联合去噪过程中使视觉流领先于 3D 对象流，从而让逐步细化的未来视觉表征引导流生成。在模拟和真实世界操作基准上的实验表明，MotionRep 在 3D 对象流准确性和对未见场景的泛化方面优于基于像素的基线，同时推理仅需三个去噪步骤。这些结果支持将预测性视觉表征作为以对象为中心的动力学建模的有效未来状态空间。

items.title_en: RIPPLE: learning nucleotide relations in an RNA foundation model
items.title_zh: RIPPLE：在 RNA 基础模型中学习核苷酸关系
items.abstract_en: RNA function depends on interactions between nucleotides that can be widely separated in sequence, yet capturing these relationships remains challenging for RNA language models. Existing approaches primarily learn nucleotide relationships implicitly from individual nucleotide reconstruction or rely on external structural information to model nucleotide interactions. Here we introduce RIPPLE, an RNA foundation model that learns to identify and represent sparse, predictively useful nucleotide relationships directly from sequence. Pretrained on 32.4 million RNA sequences, RIPPLE uses pairwise predictive utility to guide relational learning, transferring training-time supervision into a sequence-only model without requiring structural inputs at inference. RIPPLE improves overall performance across five downstream tasks spanning RNA family classification, ribosome loading prediction, secondary-structure prediction, three-dimensional contact prediction, and splice-site recognition. Mechanistic analyses further show that utility-guided learning improves the recovery of informative interactions and enhances the transferability of learned RNA representations.
items.abstract_zh: RNA 功能取决于在序列中可能相距很远的核苷酸之间的相互作用，然而对 RNA 语言模型而言，捕获这些关系仍然具有挑战性。现有方法主要从单个核苷酸重建中隐式学习核苷酸关系，或依赖外部结构信息来建模核苷酸相互作用。在此我们介绍 RIPPLE，一种 RNA 基础模型，它学习直接从序列中识别并表示稀疏的、具有预测实用性的核苷酸关系。RIPPLE 在 3240 万条 RNA 序列上预训练，利用成对预测效用指导关系学习，将训练时的监督转移到仅需序列的模型中，推理时无需结构输入。RIPPLE 在涵盖 RNA 家族分类、核糖体负载预测、二级结构预测、三维接触预测和剪接位点识别的五项下游任务上提升了整体性能。机制分析进一步表明，效用引导学习改善了信息性相互作用的恢复，并增强了所学 RNA 表征的可迁移性。

items.title_en: Cross-chip transfer in quantum photonic neural networks
items.title_zh: 量子光子神经网络中的跨芯片迁移
items.abstract_en: Fabrication variability makes it difficult to reuse one set of trained parameters across a batch of quantum photonic chips without additional chip-specific optimization. We examine how device-specific compensation and task tolerance shape cross-chip performance. For squared operator loss, local analysis predicts that reducing own-chip error through compensation incurs an increase in expected loss on independent chips. We use Monte Carlo ensemble training (MC-ENS), informed by an available statistical model of fabrication-induced parameter errors. It optimizes one shared parameter set for each task or target at a given fabrication scale by averaging losses over simulated chip realizations resampled from this model. Numerical simulations of a quantum photonic neural network compare MC-ENS with single-chip training, sharpness-aware training and a covariance-informed variant. For CNOT synthesis and Ising dynamics, MC-ENS reduces mean conditional process infidelity and increases mean postselection probability on unseen chips. In classification, high accuracy can persist despite substantial changes in the optical transformation. The decision-margin analysis shows when fabrication-induced score shifts are likely to change predicted labels. The trained shared parameters can be reused without device-specific retraining on unseen chips drawn from the same fabrication distribution.
items.abstract_zh: 制造变异性使得在一批量子光子芯片上复用一组训练参数而无需额外的芯片特定优化变得困难。我们考察器件特定补偿和任务容差如何塑造跨芯片性能。对于平方算子损失，局部分析预测，通过补偿降低本芯片误差会增加独立芯片上的期望损失。我们使用蒙特卡洛集成训练（MC-ENS），其依据是可获得的制造诱导参数误差统计模型。该方法在给定制造规模下，通过对从该模型重采样得到的模拟芯片实现上的损失取平均，为每个任务或目标优化一组共享参数。量子光子神经网络的数值模拟将 MC-ENS 与单芯片训练、锐度感知训练以及一种协方差知情变体进行比较。对于 CNOT 合成和 Ising 动力学，MC-ENS 降低了未见芯片上的平均条件过程不保真度，并提高了平均后选择概率。在分类中，尽管光学变换发生显著变化，高准确率仍可保持。决策边际分析显示了制造诱导的分数偏移何时可能改变预测标签。训练得到的共享参数可在来自同一制造分布的未见芯片上复用，而无需器件特定重训练。

items.title_en: Attack Policy Selection can Mislead Monitor Evaluators
items.title_zh: 攻击策略选择可能误导监控器评估
items.abstract_en: AI monitors, classifiers that flag dangerous behaviour by AI agents, are often evaluated against transcripts generated by attack policies acting as proxies for dangerous behaviour in deployment. We evaluate an ex-production OpenAI monitor as a case study and find that measured false negative rate is highly sensitive to both the method used to generate attack policies and the level of optimisation applied within that method. This rate ranged from 0.5\% to 20.8\% across optimisation levels of a single method (reinforcement learning), and from 6.4\% to 23.0\% across methods at their best observed optimisation level (optimised prompting vs.\ transcript editing). Every attack policy was developed against proxy monitors only: all reported results show attacks transferring to the held-out GPT-5.4 target monitor. Our results suggest that monitor evasion evaluations can easily mislead: an evaluation using only basic attack methods may give false confidence that a monitor is strong. The sensitivity to attack-policy choice raises a problem: interpreting any particular result as evidence about deployment performance requires justification. The transcripts produced by attack policies are proxies for the dangerous behaviour a monitor must flag in deployment. These proxies can introduce visible artefacts, such as reasoning about a ``side task'' absent from the instructions shown to the monitor, that affect monitor judgements. Given the sensitivity above, the choice of proxy can change an evaluation's conclusion. Reading these results as evidence about deployment therefore requires a separate legitimacy argument for why the proxies are informative, including any justification of conservativeness. Making convincing arguments remains an open problem.
items.abstract_zh: AI 监控器（对 AI 智能体的危险行为进行标记的分类器）通常依据由攻击策略生成的记录文本进行评估，这些攻击策略在部署中充当危险行为的代理。我们以一款已退出生产环境的 OpenAI 监控器为案例进行评估，发现测得的假阴性率对用于生成攻击策略的方法以及该方法内所应用的优化水平都高度敏感。在单一方法（强化学习）的不同优化水平下，该比率从 0.5% 到 20.8% 不等；在各方法最佳观测优化水平下（优化提示词 vs. 记录文本编辑），该比率从 6.4% 到 23.0% 不等。每种攻击策略都仅针对代理监控器开发：所有报告的结果均显示攻击可迁移到留出的 GPT-5.4 目标监控器。我们的结果表明，监控器规避评估很容易产生误导：仅使用基本攻击方法的评估可能会让人错误地相信监控器很强。对攻击策略选择的敏感性提出了一个问题：将任何特定结果解释为关于部署性能的证据都需要论证。攻击策略生成的记录文本是监控器在部署中必须标记的危险行为的代理。这些代理可能引入可见的伪影，例如对监控器所看指令中不存在的“侧任务”进行推理，从而影响监控器判断。鉴于上述敏感性，代理的选择可能改变评估结论。因此，将这些结果解读为关于部署的证据，需要单独提供一个合法性论证，说明这些代理为何具有信息量，包括对保守性的任何辩护。给出令人信服的论证仍是一个开放问题。

items.title_en: NORMCRAFT: Cultural Norm Generation for Context-Aware Language Model Alignment
items.title_zh: NORMCRAFT：面向上下文感知语言模型对齐的文化规范生成
items.abstract_en: Cultural alignment requires large language models (LLMs) to infer often-implicit social norms from a scenario and its cultural context. Existing approaches typically adapt individual models or supply external cultural knowledge, while learning norm inference independently of downstream response generation remains underexplored. We introduce NORMCRAFT, a modular framework that decouples norm inference from response generation. Through norm-centric multi-view supervision, we train an LLM as a norm generator to recover shared norms from prospective, adherence, and violation scenarios without downstream response labels. The generated norms guide a separate, frozen LLM (the responder). With Qwen3.5-4B as the responder, NORMCRAFT outperforms prompting and supervised fine-tuning (SFT) baselines on four of five downstream metrics. On SafeWorld, its responses reflect the reference norms more often (Coverage) and more precisely (Faithfulness), exceeding Responder SFT by 18.0 and 14.1 percentage points, respectively. Direct norm evaluation also shows higher norm quality than the base and few-shot generators. The same trained generator improves cultural alignment on SafeWorld across fourteen frozen LLMs spanning five families and 0.8B to 27B parameters, with the largest gains for the smallest models.
items.abstract_zh: 文化对齐要求大语言模型（LLM）从场景及其文化背景中推断往往隐含的社会规范。现有方法通常调整单个模型或提供外部文化知识，而独立于下游响应生成来学习规范推断仍未得到充分探索。我们提出 NORMCRAFT，一个将规范推断与响应生成解耦的模块化框架。通过以规范为中心的多视图监督，我们将 LLM 训练为规范生成器，在没有下游响应标签的情况下从前瞻性、遵从性和违规场景中恢复共享规范。生成的规范指导一个单独的、冻结的 LLM（响应器）。以 Qwen3.5-4B 作为响应器，NORMCRAFT 在五项下游指标中的四项上优于提示和监督微调（SFT）基线。在 SafeWorld 上，其响应更频繁地（Coverage）且更精确地（Faithfulness）反映参考规范，分别超过 Responder SFT 18.0 和 14.1 个百分点。直接规范评估也显示出比基础生成器和少样本生成器更高的规范质量。同一个训练好的生成器在 SafeWorld 上改善了十四个冻结 LLM 的文化对齐，这些模型跨越五个家族、参数量从 0.8B 到 27B，其中最小模型的增益最大。

items.title_en: Nav4Manip: From Navigation to Dexterous Mobile Manipulation through Co-Evolution
items.title_zh: Nav4Manip：通过协同演化从导航到灵巧移动操作
items.abstract_en: Dexterous mobile manipulation is essential for robots to perform useful tasks in complex, unstructured environments. However, existing systems face two challenges. First, navigation remains too coarse for downstream manipulation, which often requires a precise base position and approach orientation rather than merely reaching a meter-scale goal region. Second, navigation and manipulation are commonly trained in isolation, lacking a feedback loop that enables the two capabilities to co-evolve. These limitations prevent current systems from reliably executing long-horizon dexterous mobile-manipulation tasks in real-world environments. To address them, we introduce Nav4Manip, a bidirectionally coupled co-evolution system for long-horizon dexterous mobile manipulation. It comprises two complementary architectures: Nav4Manip-N learns long-horizon navigation and refines its policy through manipulation feedback, while Nav4Manip-M trains a world-action model (WAM) for downstream dexterous manipulation. We train Nav4Manip-N in three stages: multi-task co-tuning learns navigation behavior and manipulation-aware affordance prediction; rejection sampling fine-tuning (RFT) rejects low-quality policy-generated paths and fine-tunes the model on retained trajectories; and reinforcement learning from AI feedback (RLAIF) uses counterfactual preferences to further improve navigation decisions. To support this framework, we establish the Nav-N-Manip benchmark and construct Nav4Manip-Pairs from benchmark rollouts, providing large-scale paired navigation--manipulation trajectories and affordance supervision. Extensive experiments on public vision-language navigation (VLN) benchmarks and Nav-N-Manip demonstrate state-of-the-art performance, while real-world evaluations show that Nav4Manip completes diverse dexterous mobile-manipulation tasks. Project website: https://nav4manip.github.io/.
items.abstract_zh: 灵巧移动操作对于机器人在复杂、非结构化环境中执行有用任务至关重要。然而，现有系统面临两个挑战。首先，导航对于下游操作而言仍然过于粗糙，下游操作通常需要精确的基座位置和接近方向，而不仅仅是到达米级目标区域。其次，导航与操作通常被孤立训练，缺乏使这两种能力协同演化的反馈回路。这些局限使当前系统无法在真实环境中可靠执行长时程灵巧移动操作任务。为解决这些问题，我们提出 Nav4Manip，一个用于长时程灵巧移动操作的双向耦合协同演化系统。它包含两种互补架构：Nav4Manip-N 学习长时程导航，并通过操作反馈细化其策略；Nav4Manip-M 训练一个世界-动作模型（WAM）用于下游灵巧操作。我们分三阶段训练 Nav4Manip-N：多任务协同调优学习导航行为和操作感知的可供性预测；拒绝采样微调（RFT）拒绝低质量的策略生成路径，并在保留的轨迹上微调模型；基于 AI 反馈的强化学习（RLAIF）使用反事实偏好进一步改进导航决策。为支持该框架，我们建立了 Nav-N-Manip 基准，并从基准 rollout 中构建 Nav4Manip-Pairs，提供大规模配对的导航–操作轨迹和可供性监督。在公开视觉-语言导航（VLN）基准和 Nav-N-Manip 上的大量实验展示了最先进性能，而真实世界评估表明 Nav4Manip 能完成多样化的灵巧移动操作任务。项目网站：https://nav4manip.github.io/。

items.title_en: One Patch, Many Policies: Object-Associated Physical Patch Attacks on Robotic Manipulation
items.title_zh: 单补丁，多策略：面向机器人操作的对象关联物理补丁攻击
items.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) and World Action Models (WAMs) are vulnerable to adversarial visual interference, motivating the study of universal and transferable physical patch attacks. We propose Object-Associated Patch Attack (OAPA), a universal and transferable physical patch framework that enables an attacker to select which task object's manipulation to disrupt through patch placement, without re-optimizing the patch. Our framework combines object-associated placement, differentiable physical compositing, and final action-expert representation divergence. Physical compositing accounts for perspective and occlusion across camera views, while representation divergence guides patch optimization using either relative RMS or cosine distance. Experimental results demonstrate strong attack transferability across task suites and policies, together with the ability to selectively disrupt manipulation of an attacker-chosen task object through patch placement.
items.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型和世界动作模型（WAMs）易受对抗性视觉干扰影响，这促使了对通用且可迁移的物理补丁攻击的研究。我们提出对象关联补丁攻击（Object-Associated Patch Attack, OAPA），一种通用且可迁移的物理补丁框架，使攻击者能够通过补丁放置选择要干扰哪个任务对象的操作，而无需重新优化补丁。我们的框架结合了对象关联放置、可微物理合成以及最终动作专家表示差异。物理合成考虑了跨相机视角的透视和遮挡，而表示差异使用相对RMS或余弦距离引导补丁优化。实验结果表明，跨任务套件和策略具有强攻击可迁移性，并且能够通过补丁放置选择性地干扰攻击者所选任务对象的操作。

items.title_en: Deep Learning-based Phylodynamic Inference of Oropouche Virus Transmission Dynamics in Brazil Between 2023 and 2025
items.title_zh: 基于深度学习的2023至2025年巴西奥罗普切病毒传播动态的系统发育动力学推断
items.abstract_en: Oropouche virus caused an unprecedented epidemic across the Americas during 2023-2025, associated with the expansion of the reassortant M1L2S2 lineage. To investigate its dissemination, we develop the Birth-Death Exposed-Infectious Vector-Human (BDEIVH) model within a deep-learning framework that explicitly represents alternating human-vector transmission and incubation periods. The model defines two directional reproduction numbers, RVH and RHV, whose product, RHH, quantifies the expected number of secondary human infections generated by a single infectious human through one complete transmission cycle. In simulations, BDEIVH provides more accurate RHH estimates than conventional birth-death models, with predictive accuracy improving with phylogeny size and remaining robust under reduced phylogenetic resolution. Across three major Brazilian OROV genomic clusters, estimated durations of infection range from 15.4 to 18.5 days in vectors and from 9.42 to 12.3 days in humans, whereas whole-cluster RHH estimates range from 1.15 to 1.81. RHH estimates reached a peak of 4.4 in the endemic Amazon region and 3.0 in the non-endemic Atlantic Forest region. These findings show that explicitly modelling vector-mediated transmission improves phylodynamic inference and reveals substantial OROV transmission in both endemic and non-endemic regions.
items.abstract_zh: 奥罗普切病毒在2023—2025年期间在美洲引起了前所未有的流行，这与重配的M1L2S2谱系扩张有关。为研究其传播，我们在深度学习框架内开发了出生-死亡暴露-感染媒介-人（BDEIVH）模型，该模型显式表示交替的人-媒介传播和潜伏期。该模型定义了两个方向性繁殖数RVH和RHV，其乘积RHH量化了单个感染者在一次完整传播周期中产生的预期二代人类感染数。在模拟中，BDEIVH提供的RHH估计比传统出生-死亡模型更准确，预测准确性随系统发育树规模增大而提高，并在系统发育分辨率降低时保持稳健。在巴西三个主要OROV基因组簇中，估计的感染持续时间在媒介中为15.4至18.5天，在人类中为9.42至12.3天，而整个簇的RHH估计范围为1.15至1.81。RHH估计在地方性流行的亚马孙地区达到峰值4.4，在非地方性流行的大西洋森林地区达到3.0。这些发现表明，显式建模媒介介导的传播可改进系统发育动力学推断，并揭示OROV在地方性和非地方性流行地区均存在大量传播。

items.title_en: PerovAgent: Autonomous Ligand Design for Halide Perovskite Nanocrystals
items.title_zh: PerovAgent：卤化物钙钛矿纳米晶的自主配体设计
items.abstract_en: Designing surface-capping ligands for high-performance halide perovskite nanocrystals requires navigating a vast molecular space while discovering design rules that govern ligand-surface interactions. Here, we introduce PerovAgent, an autonomous multi-agent framework that combines large language model (LLM)-driven scientific reasoning with computational tools for atomistic model construction, machine-learned interatomic potential evaluation, and statistical validation. Across ten independent campaigns on CsPbBr3 surfaces, PerovAgent adaptively explored and refined diverse ligand chemistries while progressively improving the binding-energy objective. Beyond optimization, the framework converts recurring chemical observations into explicit design principles that can be statistically evaluated. Of 35 formulated principles, 19 were prospectively supported, of which seven also passed the confound audit, highlighting the need to systematically validate plausible LLM-generated hypotheses during autonomous discovery. A recurrent alkynyl-phosphonate principle was further examined using density functional theory, which reproduced the predicted energetic preference. These results demonstrate an autonomous discovery framework that not only searches molecular space and optimizes the scalar objective but also transforms its search trajectory into systematically testable design principles. The framework can also be extended to more complex ligands, including zwitterionic, multidentate, and polymerizable ligands, to explore a wider range of ligand-surface interactions and uncover new design principles for halide perovskite nanocrystals.
items.abstract_zh: 为高性能卤化物钙钛矿纳米晶设计表面封端配体，需要在巨大分子空间中导航，同时发现支配配体-表面相互作用的设计规则。在此，我们介绍PerovAgent，一个自主多智能体框架，它将大语言模型（LLM）驱动的科学推理与用于原子模型构建、机器学习原子间势评估和统计验证的计算工具相结合。在CsPbBr3表面上的十次独立行动中，PerovAgent自适应地探索并细化多种配体化学，同时逐步改善结合能目标。除优化之外，该框架还将反复出现的化学观察转化为可进行统计评估的显式设计原则。在35条制定的原则中，有19条得到前瞻性支持，其中7条还通过了混杂因素审计，这凸显了在自主发现过程中系统验证看似合理的LLM生成假设的必要性。利用密度泛函理论进一步检验了一条反复出现的炔基-膦酸酯原则，其重现了预测的能量偏好。这些结果展示了一个自主发现框架，它不仅搜索分子空间并优化标量目标，还将搜索轨迹转化为可系统检验的设计原则。该框架还可扩展到更复杂的配体，包括两性离子、多齿和可聚合配体，以探索更广泛的配体-表面相互作用，并揭示卤化物钙钛矿纳米晶的新设计原则。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为语言模型与推理，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: Split-RL: Local Conflict Resolution in Reinforcement Learning
items.title_zh: Split-RL：强化学习中的局部冲突消解
items.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) policies are often trained by mixing contradictory feedback that is localized in space and time. For example, a robot may prioritize speed in open areas versus precision in tight gaps. We introduce Split-RL, a Gradient Boosting Trees (GBT) algorithm that uses guidance labels to locally isolate these conflicting signals. Standard neural networks (NNs) lack the structural mechanism to do this, as their parameters share feedback from all sources. While GBT provides the inductive bias to explicitly partition the state-space per objective, standard tree-fitting procedures aggregate contradictory gradient signals before they reach the leaves. Split-RL leverages this bias to integrate guidance labels into tree construction, routing these updates into disjoint state-space regions and preventing signal interference. Such labels can arise from heuristics, sensor-derived events, or existing rule-based systems, allowing Split-RL to incorporate rule-derived structure while retaining a learned policy. We theoretically show how early gradient aggregation loses objective-specific information and characterize when the Split-RL score isolates conflicting updates. We focus on constrained RL and offline RL with mixed datasets, each balancing two objectives that conflict locally. Across domains with spatial, rare-event, and temporal conflicts, Split-RL consistently outperforms existing methods by meeting the episodic cost budget while maintaining competitive rewards. In offline settings, Split-RL localizes the tradeoff between imitation and policy improvement, outperforming other methods and achieving near-expert performance across varying dataset sizes.
items.abstract_zh: 强化学习（RL）策略通常通过混合在空间和时间上局部化的相互矛盾反馈来训练。例如，机器人可能在开阔区域优先考虑速度，而在狭窄间隙中优先考虑精度。我们提出Split-RL，一种梯度提升树（GBT）算法，它使用引导标签来局部隔离这些冲突信号。标准神经网络（NN）缺乏做到这一点的结构机制，因为其参数共享来自所有来源的反馈。虽然GBT提供了按目标显式划分状态空间的归纳偏置，但标准树拟合过程会在矛盾梯度信号到达叶子之前将其聚合。Split-RL利用这种偏置将引导标签整合到树构建中，将这些更新路由到不相交的状态空间区域，并防止信号干扰。此类标签可来自启发式规则、传感器衍生事件或现有基于规则的系统，使Split-RL能够纳入规则衍生的结构，同时保留学习到的策略。我们从理论上说明了早期梯度聚合如何丢失目标特定信息，并刻画了Split-RL得分何时隔离冲突更新。我们关注约束RL和具有混合数据集的离线RL，二者均平衡两个局部冲突的目标。在具有空间、稀有事件和时间冲突的各个领域中，Split-RL通过满足回合成本预算并保持有竞争力的奖励，始终优于现有方法。在离线设置中，Split-RL将模仿与策略改进之间的权衡局部化，优于其他方法，并在不同数据集规模下达到接近专家的性能。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为机器人感知与控制，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: The Platonic Representation Hypothesis in Jacobian-Space: Language and Vision Models Agree Approximately Up to a Rotation
items.title_zh: 雅可比空间中的柏拉图表示假说：语言模型与视觉模型在相差一个旋转的范围内近似一致
items.abstract_en: The Platonic Representation Hypothesis (PRH) posits that AI models converge toward a shared representation of the world, even when trained on different data modalities. Previous work has found evidence for the PRH in the activations of vision and language models. In this work, we ask whether vision and language models also converge in how they act on these representations: precisely, in how these internal representations affect the models' output. At a chosen layer of a transformer, the Jacobian lens gives every word in the vocabulary (or class in an image classifier) a vector in the hidden state: the vector that most increases the model's tendency to generate that word, at that position or later, or to predict that class. Collectively, these vectors make up what is referred to as the model's J-space. We find evidence of the PRH in J-space across vision and language models, and furthermore, we find that J-spaces mostly converge up to a rotation. That is, a single rotation, fitted on a subset of words, approximately maps one model's J-space onto another's, and so applies to words and classes it was not fitted on. A word's vector, rotated from a text-only language model's J-space into the visual patch tokens of a vision-language model, changes the object the vision-language model says is in the image (and only in the image region where it is added). Rotated into an image generator's text conditioning, a word's vector changes the object in the generated image. Rotated into an ImageNet classifier (trained without text), it raises that object's class score above almost all others, and vice versa. This suggests that models converge not only in how they represent the world, but also in how they act on it.
items.abstract_zh: 柏拉图表示假说（PRH）认为，AI模型会趋同于一种共享的世界表示，即使是在不同数据模态上训练时也是如此。先前的工作已在视觉和语言模型的激活中发现了PRH的证据。在本工作中，我们追问视觉和语言模型是否也在它们如何作用于这些表示上趋同：确切地说，是在这些内部表示如何影响模型输出上趋同。在 transformer 的选定层，雅可比透镜为词汇表中的每个词（或图像分类器中的每个类别）给出隐藏状态中的一个向量：该向量最能增加模型在该位置或之后生成该词的倾向，或预测该类别的倾向。这些向量共同构成了所谓的模型的J空间。我们在视觉和语言模型的J空间中发现了PRH的证据，并且进一步发现，J空间大多在相差一个旋转的意义下趋同。也就是说，一个在部分单词子集上拟合的单一旋转，可以近似地将一个模型的J空间映射到另一个模型的J空间，因而也适用于未参与拟合的单词和类别。将一个单词的向量从纯文本语言模型的J空间旋转到视觉-语言模型的视觉图像块 token 中，会改变视觉-语言模型所说的图像中的物体（且仅在被添加的图像区域中）。将其旋转到图像生成器的文本条件中，该单词向量会改变生成图像中的物体。将其旋转到一个ImageNet分类器（未用文本训练）中，会将该物体的类别得分提高到几乎高于所有其他类别，反之亦然。这表明模型不仅在如何表示世界上趋同，也在如何作用于世界上趋同。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为生成与多模态，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: End-to-End Image-Goal Navigation for Agile Quadrotors via Recurrent State Distillation
items.title_zh: 通过循环状态蒸馏实现敏捷四旋翼的端到端图像目标导航
items.abstract_en: Image-goal navigation asks a robot to reach the viewpoint of a target photograph without a map or goal pose. In three dimensions, this requires not only recognizing the goal but also estimating 3D displacement and generating continuous control actions to approach and settle at the target view. This is difficult because the same visual difference between current and goal image can require very different actions depending on the robot's velocity, yet monocular images alone reveal neither metric scale nor body motion. As a result, existing image-goal policies are limited to planar action spaces and rely on a state estimator for flight control. Policies that map directly from images to low-level control commands have been demonstrated for agile flight, but not toward goal images in unseen environments. We present the first image-goal navigation policy that directly commands thrust and angular rates for agile quadrotor flight in unseen 3D environments, without relying on state estimation (e.g., SLAM, VO, or SfM) or a separate velocity controller. We train a recurrent vision-based policy through a four-stage pipeline that combines geometric and motion supervision with privileged-teacher distillation and end-to-end reinforcement learning fine-tuning. On 1000 held-out flights in unseen environments, the policy achieves an 82.3% success rate with a mean terminal position error of 0.10m across successful flights. Deployed zero-shot on a real quadrotor, the policy reaches an 84% success rate over 25 trials in an unseen indoor environment.
items.abstract_zh: 图像目标导航要求机器人在没有地图或目标位姿的情况下到达目标照片的视点。在三维环境中，这不仅需要识别目标，还需要估计3D位移并生成连续控制动作，以接近并稳定在目标视图。这很困难，因为当前图像与目标图像之间相同的视觉差异可能根据机器人速度而需要非常不同的动作，而单目图像本身既不揭示度量尺度，也不揭示机体运动。因此，现有的图像目标策略局限于平面动作空间，并依赖状态估计器进行飞行控制。直接从图像映射到低层控制指令的策略已在敏捷飞行中得到演示，但尚未用于未见环境中的目标图像。我们提出了首个图像目标导航策略，可直接输出推力和角速率指令，用于在未见3D环境中进行敏捷四旋翼飞行，而不依赖状态估计（例如SLAM、VO或SfM）或单独的速度控制器。我们通过四阶段流程训练基于视觉的循环策略，该流程将几何和运动监督与特权教师蒸馏以及端到端强化学习微调相结合。在未见环境中的1000次留出飞行中，该策略达到82.3%的成功率，成功飞行的平均终端位置误差为0.10米。在真实四旋翼上零样本部署时，该策略在未见室内环境中的25次试验中达到84%的成功率。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为三维与定位，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: Embodied-VGGT: Preserving Reliable Local Geometry for Long-Sequence Reconstruction
items.title_zh: Embodied-VGGT：为长序列重建保留可靠的局部几何
items.abstract_en: Long sequence reconstruction must correct accumulated drift while preserving locally consistent geometry. In robotics and autonomous driving, embodied acquisition provides recurring platform- environment geometry and repeated observations of scene structure and platform motion. We present Embodied-VGGT, which exploits these cues to establish reliable local relationships and selectively preserve them during global refinement. Memory-Augmented Grounded Chunks (MAGC) builds on Scal3R's global context memory and uses relative scale references derived from predicted ground geometry to regularize test-time memory updates, encouraging cross-chunk consistency while limiting changes to reliable local geometry. Superpoint Alignment (SA) and Cross-Loop Optimization (CL) jointly address the robust establishment and preservation of geometric relationships. SA balances ground and non-ground evidence across spatial regions to estimate inter-chunk translation. CL uses geometric and motion consistency across interleaved windows to select coherent chunk groups, each receiving a shared Sim(3) correction that preserves its internal relative transformations during global optimization. Experiments on five public driving benchmarks demonstrate consistent and substantial improvements in long sequence reconstruction. On KITTI Odometry, Embodied-VGGT achieves a mean absolute trajectory error of 7.30 m and a Chamfer distance of 2.67 m, reducing these errors by 46.8% and 23.3% compared with the state-of-the-art baseline under same evaluation protocol. To facilitate reproducibility, we released our code: https://github.com/Ang-Sheep/Embodied-VGGT.
items.abstract_zh: 长序列重建必须在修正累积漂移的同时保留局部一致的几何。在机器人学和自动驾驶中，具身采集提供了反复出现的平台—环境几何，以及对场景结构和平台运动的重复观测。我们提出 Embodied-VGGT，利用这些线索建立可靠的局部关系，并在全局优化过程中选择性地保留这些关系。Memory-Augmented Grounded Chunks（MAGC）建立在 Scal3R 的全局上下文记忆之上，并利用由预测地面几何得到的相对尺度参考来正则化测试时记忆更新，在限制对可靠局部几何进行改变的同时促进跨块一致性。Superpoint Alignment（SA）与 Cross-Loop Optimization（CL）共同解决几何关系的稳健建立与保留问题。SA 在空间区域间平衡地面与非地面证据，以估计块间平移。CL 利用交错窗口间的几何与运动一致性来选择连贯的块组，每个块组在全局优化期间获得共享的 Sim(3) 校正，从而保留其内部相对变换。在五个公开驾驶基准上的实验表明，长序列重建获得一致且显著的改进。在 KITTI Odometry 上，Embodied-VGGT 达到 7.30 m 的平均绝对轨迹误差和 2.67 m 的 Chamfer 距离，在相同评估协议下，相比最先进基线分别降低 46.8% 和 23.3% 的误差。为便于复现，我们发布了代码：https://github.com/Ang-Sheep/Embodied-VGGT。

items.title_en: Bayesian Learning of Spatially Heterogeneous Causal Structure in Spatial Transcriptomics
items.title_zh: 空间转录组学中空间异质因果结构的贝叶斯学习
items.abstract_en: Spatial transcriptomics preserves the location of each expression profile, making it possible to study how gene regulatory networks differ within a tissue. Across regions of a tissue, regulatory relationships may vary and even reverse direction, so identifying the causal relationships in a specific pathological region can provide insight into therapeutic targets. We propose SpaDAG, a Bayesian method for learning spatially varying causal directed acyclic graphs. By defining the graphs on a triangulation of the tissue, SpaDAG allows each edge to have its own spatial pattern and even to reverse direction across regions. We show that the graphs nonetheless remain fully identifiable, and develop an MCMC sampler that explores them efficiently by reversing an edge over an entire connected region in a single move. SpaDAG outperforms competing methods in simulations with and without direction reversals. In a section spanning a renal cell carcinoma and the adjacent kidney, SpaDAG finds largely different relationships in the two tissues, with those in the tumor concentrated on genes associated with therapeutic targets. Between two of these genes, it identifies a relationship whose direction reverses across the tumor boundary, generating hypotheses about their region-specific coupling. Supplementary materials and code for this article are available online.
items.abstract_zh: 空间转录组学保留了每个表达谱的位置，使得研究基因调控网络在组织内如何不同成为可能。在组织的不同区域，调控关系可能变化甚至方向反转，因此识别特定病理区域中的因果 relationship 可为治疗靶点提供见解。我们提出 SpaDAG，一种用于学习空间变化因果有向无环图的贝叶斯方法。通过在组织的三角剖分上定义图，SpaDAG 允许每条边具有自己的空间模式，甚至在不同区域间反转方向。我们证明这些图仍然完全可识别，并开发了一种 MCMC 采样器，通过单次移动在整个连通区域上反转一条边来高效探索这些图。在有无方向反转的模拟中，SpaDAG 均优于竞争方法。在跨越肾细胞癌及相邻肾脏的切片中，SpaDAG 发现两种组织中 largely 不同的关系，其中肿瘤中的关系集中于与治疗靶点相关的基因。在这些基因中的两个之间，它识别出一种在肿瘤边界两侧方向反转的关系，从而生成关于其区域特异性耦合的假设。本文的补充材料和代码可在线获取。

items.title_en: Transport Layer-Driven Optimization of Color and Efficiency in TADF OLEDs for Large-Area Applications
items.title_zh: 面向大面积应用的 TADF OLED 中传输层驱动的颜色与效率优化
items.abstract_en: Balancing structural simplicity with high efficiency is crucial for practical applications of organic light-emitting diodes (OLEDs), especially in large-area lighting devices. Optimizing the charge-transport layers in multilayer OLEDs controls the recombination zone within the emissive layer, thereby enhancing the device's performance. Herein, we experimentally and computationally investigate how the thicknesses of the electron and hole transport layers affect the performance of orange-red thermally activated delayed fluorescence (TADF) OLEDs. Using a TADF emitter, 2-[4-(diphenylamino)phenyl]-10,10-dioxide-9H-thioxanthen-9-one (TXO-TPA), at 10 wt\% concentration in 4,4-Bis(N-carbazolyl)-1,1-biphenyl (CBP) host, we achieve a maximum external quantum efficiency ($η_{EQE}$) of 20.86\% and a peak luminance of 32,800 cd m$^{-2}$. Using a combination of drift-diffusion and optical simulations, we reveal how variations in hole- and electron-transport-layer thicknesses modulate the charge-carrier balance and shift the recombination zone within the emissive layer. This tuning not only optimizes exciton formation but also enables color tuning from green to red without altering the emissive material. Our findings highlight the critical role of transport layer engineering in achieving efficient, color-controlled OLEDs with simplified architectures. Furthermore, we successfully demonstrate a large-area OLED device (~20 cm$^{2}$), achieving an impressive $η_{EQE}$ of 17\%, underscoring the scalability and practicality of our approach for general lighting applications.
items.abstract_zh: 在结构简单性与高效率之间取得平衡，对于有机发光二极管（OLED）的实际应用至关重要，尤其是在大面积照明器件中。优化多层 OLED 中的电荷传输层可控制发光层内的复合区，从而提升器件性能。本文通过实验和计算研究电子传输层与空穴传输层的厚度如何影响橙红色热活化延迟荧光（TADF）OLED 的性能。使用 TADF 发光体 2-[4-(diphenylamino)phenyl]-10,10-dioxide-9H-thioxanthen-9-one（TXO-TPA），在 4,4-Bis(N-carbazolyl)-1,1-biphenyl（CBP）主体中以 10 wt% 浓度，我们实现了 20.86% 的最大外量子效率（η_EQE）和 32,800 cd m⁻² 的峰值亮度。结合漂移-扩散与光学模拟，我们揭示了空穴传输层和电子传输层厚度的变化如何调节电荷载流子平衡并移动发光层内的复合区。这种调节不仅优化了激子形成，还能在不改变发光材料的情况下实现从绿色到红色的颜色调谐。我们的发现凸显了传输层工程在实现结构简化、颜色可控的高效 OLED 中的关键作用。此外，我们成功展示了一个大面积 OLED 器件（约 20 cm²），实现了 17% 的 η_EQE，凸显了该方法在通用照明应用中的可扩展性与实用性。

items.title_en: Distractor-Robust Reinforcement Learning via Variational Bisimulation
items.title_zh: 通过变分双模拟实现干扰鲁棒的强化学习
items.abstract_en: Model-based reinforcement learning (MBRL) promises data efficiency and generalization, but typical reconstruction-based objectives encourage models to waste representational capacity on task-irrelevant distractors. We introduce VIBES (Variational Inference for Bisimulation-based Encoded States), a new objective that replaces pixel reconstruction with an adversarial term, which enforces that latent states suffice to predict both rewards and the next latent state. We show that this objective measures how far the encoder is from reward and dynamics sufficiency, and that whenever exact sufficiency is attainable, its global optima induce bisimulation relations on histories. Combined with a fixed-capacity latent bottleneck, this encourages latent states to retain task-relevant information while discarding irrelevant variation. Our method serves as a drop-in replacement for Dreamer's model-learning component, achieves state-of-the-art performance on the Distracting Control Suite, and extends to visually complex manipulation in Realistic ManiSkill. Unlike prior approaches, it does not rely on image-specific augmentations and applies equally well to high-dimensional vector-state tasks, demonstrated on a 100-link swimmer robot. Finally, latent-space analyses (UMAP embeddings and nearest-neighbor probes) confirm that the learned representations are sensitive to task-relevant structure while invariant to distractors.
items.abstract_zh: 基于模型的强化学习（MBRL）有望实现数据效率和泛化能力，但典型的基于重建的目标会促使模型将表示能力浪费在与任务无关的干扰物上。我们提出 VIBES（Variational Inference for Bisimulation-based Encoded States），一种新的目标，用对抗项替代像素重建，强制潜在状态足以预测奖励和下一潜在状态。我们证明该目标衡量编码器距离奖励充分性和动力学充分性有多远，并且只要精确充分性可达到，其全局最优解就会在历史上诱导出双模拟关系。结合固定容量的潜在瓶颈，这促使潜在状态保留任务相关信息，同时丢弃无关变化。我们的方法可作为 Dreamer 模型学习组件的即插即用替代，在 Distracting Control Suite 上取得最先进性能，并扩展到 Realistic ManiSkill 中视觉复杂的操作任务。与先前方法不同，它不依赖图像特定的增强，并且同样适用于高维向量状态任务，在 100 连杆游泳机器人上得到了展示。最后，潜在空间分析（UMAP 嵌入与最近邻探针）确认，所学表示对任务相关结构敏感，同时对干扰物不变。

items.title_en: When Ink Meets Pixel: Intent-Aware OCR with VLMs for Human-Corrected Financial Documents
items.title_zh: 当墨迹遇见像素：面向人工校正金融文档的 VLM 意图感知 OCR
items.abstract_en: Human annotations on documents (such as arrows, carets, strikethroughs, and insertions) express corrective intent yet existing OCR and document understanding systems treat these marks as visual noise rather than semantic edit operations. We introduce intent-aware OCR, the task of generating corrected transcriptions by jointly reasoning over original document content and visual intent cues (handwritten or digital) that convey edit intent. To support this setting, we present DocIntent, a multimodal dataset of 1,600 financial documents with over 5,700 annotated visual intent cues, each paired with layout-aware, intent-resolved OCR targets. We further introduce IntentBench, a 216-document benchmark designed to evaluate model robustness under diverse real-world annotation conditions. Leveraging DocIntent, we fine-tune DocIntentOCR, a suite of 3B and 7B parameter vision-language models, under direct intent supervision on corrected transcriptions. On IntentBench, the fine-tuned 3B and 7B models achieve F1-scores of 0.81 and 0.83, respectively, substantially outperforming commercial closed-source (e.g., GPT-4.1 (0.626)), and open-source models (e.g., LLaMA-3.2-Vision-90B (0.50)) demonstrating that intent-aware supervision enables compact domain-specific models to outperform substantially larger general-purpose systems on this task. This work establishes intent-aware OCR as a novel human-in-the-loop document understanding task and provides foundational resources (dataset, benchmark, models) to advance research in interactive document processing.
items.abstract_zh: 文档上的人工标注（如箭头、插入符、删除线和插入内容）表达校正意图，但现有 OCR 和文档理解系统将这些标记视为视觉噪声，而非语义编辑操作。我们引入意图感知 OCR，该任务通过联合推理原始文档内容与传达编辑意图的视觉意图线索（手写或数字）来生成校正后的转写文本。为支持这一设定，我们提出 DocIntent，一个包含 1,600 份金融文档、超过 5,700 个标注视觉意图线索的多模态数据集，每个线索均 paired 有布局感知、意图解析后的 OCR 目标。我们进一步引入 IntentBench，一个包含 216 份文档的基准，用于评估模型在多样真实世界标注条件下的鲁棒性。利用 DocIntent，我们在校正转写文本上以直接意图监督微调 DocIntentOCR，即一套 3B 和 7B 参数的视觉语言模型。在 IntentBench 上，微调后的 3B 和 7B 模型分别取得 0.81 和 0.83 的 F1 分数，显著优于商业闭源模型（例如 GPT-4.1（0.626））和开源模型（例如 LLaMA-3.2-Vision-90B（0.50）），表明意图感知监督使紧凑的领域特定模型在该任务上能够超越大得多的通用系统。本工作确立了意图感知 OCR 作为一种新的人机协同文档理解任务，并提供基础资源（数据集、基准、模型）以推进交互式文档处理研究。

items.title_en: FOCI: Trajectory Optimization on Gaussian Splats for Gaussian Robots
items.title_zh: FOCI：面向高斯机器人的高斯泼溅轨迹优化
items.abstract_en: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has recently gained popularity as a faster alternative to Neural Radiance Fields (NeRFs) in 3D reconstruction and view synthesis methods. Leveraging the spatial information encoded in 3DGS, this work proposes FOCI (Field Overlap Collision Integral), an algorithm that is able to optimize trajectories directly on the Gaussians themselves. FOCI leverages a novel and interpretable collision formulation for 3DGS using the notion of the overlap integral between Gaussians. The formulation presented applies to different robot morphologies (e.g., fixed and mobile base manipulators, legged robots, UAVs) and handles both static and dynamic Gaussian-Splat environments. Contrary to other approaches, which represent the robot with conservative bounding boxes that underestimate the traversability of the environment, we propose to represent the environment and the robot as Gaussian Splats. This not only has desirable computational properties, but also allows for orientation-aware planning, allowing the robot to pass through very tight and narrow spaces. We extensively test our algorithm in both synthetic and real Gaussian Splats, showcasing that collision-free trajectories for legged, aerial and manipulator robots can be computed in seconds, even with hundreds of thousands of Gaussians making up the environment. The code is available at https://github.com/leggedrobotics/foci
items.abstract_zh: 3D Gaussian Splatting（3DGS）最近作为 NeRF 在三维重建和视图合成方法中的更快替代方案而受到欢迎。利用 3DGS 中编码的空间信息，本文提出 FOCI（Field Overlap Collision Integral），一种能够直接在高斯本身上优化轨迹的算法。FOCI 利用高斯之间重叠积分这一概念，为 3DGS 提出了一种新颖且可解释的碰撞公式。所提出的公式适用于不同的机器人形态（例如固定基座和移动基座机械臂、腿足机器人、无人机），并处理静态和动态高斯泼溅环境。与其他用保守边界框表示机器人、从而低估环境可通行性的方法相反，我们提出将环境和机器人表示为高斯泼溅。这不仅具有理想的計算性质，还允许方向感知规划，使机器人能够通过非常紧凑和狭窄的空间。我们在合成和真实高斯泼溅中广泛测试了该算法，展示了即使环境中包含数十万个高斯，也能在数秒内计算出腿足、空中和机械臂机器人的无碰撞轨迹。代码见 https://github.com/leggedrobotics/foci。

items.title_en: NeRF: Representing Scenes as Neural Radiance Fields for View Synthesis
items.abstract_en: We present a method that achieves state-of-the-art results for synthesizing novel views of complex scenes by optimizing an underlying continuous volumetric scene function using a sparse set of input views. Our algorithm represents a scene using a fully-connected (non-convolutional) deep network, whose input is a single continuous 5D coordinate (spatial location $(x,y,z)$ and viewing direction $(θ, φ)$) and whose output is the volume density and view-dependent emitted radiance at that spatial location. We synthesize views by querying 5D coordinates along camera rays and use classic volume rendering techniques to project the output colors and densities into an image. Because volume rendering is naturally differentiable, the only input required to optimize our representation is a set of images with known camera poses. We describe how to effectively optimize neural radiance fields to render photorealistic novel views of scenes with complicated geometry and appearance, and demonstrate results that outperform prior work on neural rendering and view synthesis. View synthesis results are best viewed as videos, so we urge readers to view our supplementary video for convincing comparisons.

items.title_zh: NeRF：将场景表示为用于视图合成的神经辐射场
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种方法，通过使用稀疏的输入视图优化底层连续体积场景函数，在合成复杂场景的新视图方面取得了最先进的结果。我们的算法使用全连接（非卷积）深度网络表示场景，其输入是单个连续5D坐标（空间位置 $(x,y,z)$ 和观察方向 $(θ, φ)$），输出是该空间位置处的体积密度和与视角相关的发射辐射亮度。我们通过沿相机光线查询5D坐标来合成视图，并使用经典体积渲染技术将输出的颜色和密度投影到图像中。由于体积渲染天然可微，优化我们的表示所需的唯一输入是一组已知相机位姿的图像。我们描述了如何有效优化神经辐射场，以渲染具有复杂几何形状和外观的场景的逼真新视图，并展示了优于先前神经渲染和视图合成工作的结果。视图合成结果最好以视频形式观看，因此我们敦促读者观看我们的补充视频以进行有说服力的比较。

items.title_en: Cell and nuclear shapes predict confined motility
items.title_zh: 细胞与细胞核形状预测受限运动能力
items.abstract_en: Cancer metastasis relies on an enhanced property of cells to migrate efficiently even through constrictions smaller than their nucleus. Both cell and nuclear morphology may influence this process. How these morphologies relate to the likelihood that a cell will transit through a constriction remains unclear. Here we combine microfluidic experiments with machine learning to predict whether MDA-MB-231 breast cancer cells are able to transit through narrow constrictions. Cells migrate within vertically confined boxes, and may migrate into neighboring boxes by transiting through constrictions, requiring a deformation of the nucleus. Defining a set of 12 geometrical features derived from cell and nuclear contours, we find that their average values are not statistically indicative of whether or not a cell will transit. To overcome this limitation, we use trajectories to train classifiers and evaluate their ability to predict future transit events. We find that the cell area and cell circularity carry most of the predictive information and less circular cells are more likely to transit. Without retraining, the models also predict transit through narrower constrictions and in more adhesive substrates. Morphological features of cells about 30 minutes before a transit event proved most informative about future transit events occurring or not. Together, our results show that cell shape, readable from simple contour descriptors, contains a transferable but condition-dependent signature of imminent transit.
items.abstract_zh: 癌症转移依赖于细胞增强的特性，即使通过小于其细胞核的收缩处也能高效迁移。细胞和细胞核形态都可能影响这一过程。这些形态与细胞通过收缩处的可能性之间的关系仍不清楚。在此，我们将微流控实验与机器学习相结合，预测MDA-MB-231乳腺癌细胞是否能够通过狭窄收缩处。细胞在垂直受限的盒子内迁移，并可能通过穿过收缩处迁移到相邻盒子，这需要细胞核变形。我们定义了由细胞和细胞核轮廓导出的12个几何特征，发现它们的平均值在统计上不能指示细胞是否会通过。为克服这一局限，我们使用轨迹训练分类器，并评估其预测未来通过事件的能力。我们发现细胞面积和细胞圆度携带了大部分预测信息，且较不圆的细胞更可能通过。无需重新训练，模型还能预测通过更窄收缩处以及在更具黏附性的基底中的通过情况。细胞在通过事件前约30分钟的形态特征被证明对预测未来是否发生通过事件最具信息量。总之，我们的结果表明，可从简单轮廓描述子读取的细胞形状包含一种可迁移但依赖条件的即将通过的特征。

items.title_en: Deep-learning-enabled rapid spatially multiplexed wavefront sensing with a thin diffuser
items.title_zh: 基于深度学习的薄扩散器快速空间复用波前传感
items.abstract_en: Conventional wavefront sensing typically measures aberrations along a single guide-star direction, limiting the correction of field-dependent aberrations over a wide field of view. Spatial multiplexing with a thin diffuser enables simultaneous measurements across multiple isoplanatic patches, but the computational cost of reconstruction makes it difficult to track changing aberrations. We propose a deep-learning approach that combines recurrent all-pairs field transforms for displacement estimation with Zernike coefficient regression. Experimental results show that the method accurately reconstructs multiple wavefronts from a single speckle pattern and reduces three-channel reconstruction time from 2801.6 ms with conventional digital image correlation (DIC) to 23.1 ms. The reconstructed wavefronts agreed more closely with sequential single-channel references than those obtained by multiplexed DIC, and simulations showed that Zernike regression was more robust to noise than direct gradient integration. These results suggest a path toward dynamic wide-field aberration sensing and high-speed adaptive optics.
items.abstract_zh: 传统波前传感通常沿单个导星方向测量像差，限制了对宽视场内依赖视场的像差的校正。使用薄扩散器的空间复用能够同时测量多个等晕区，但重建的计算成本使得难以跟踪变化的像差。我们提出一种深度学习方法，将用于位移估计的循环全对场变换与Zernike系数回归相结合。实验结果表明，该方法能从单个散斑图案准确重建多个波前，并将三通道重建时间从传统数字图像相关（DIC）的2801.6 ms降低到23.1 ms。重建波前与顺序单通道参考的吻合程度高于复用DIC获得的结果，仿真表明Zernike回归比直接梯度积分对噪声更稳健。这些结果为实现动态宽场像差传感和高速自适应光学提供了一条路径。

items.title_en: BRIAR: Martingale Belief Smoothing on Bifurcation-Guided Reasoning Trees
items.title_zh: BRIAR：分叉引导推理树上的鞅信念平滑
items.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has rapidly advanced long-chain reasoning, yet standard policy optimizers distribute rollout compute and gradient credit blindly across a trajectory. On hard problems, an early misstep derails the remaining trace, whereas on solvable problems, the policy keeps generating redundant verification long after the answer is already determined. We trace both pathologies to a single structural fact: under an on-policy verifier, the true prefix pass probability $V^π(u)$ along a reasoning trace forms a $[0,1]$-bounded Doob martingale whose learnable credit variance is strictly conserved and bounded above by $V^π(u)(1-V^π(u))$, vanishing at both the derailed ($V^π\to 0$) and absorbed ($V^π\to 1$) boundaries. We introduce BRIAR (Bifurcation-guided Rollout and Inference on Adaptive Reasoning trees), a tree-structured RLVR framework built directly around this martingale geometry. First, BRIAR expands discourse-aligned reasoning trees along an upper-confidence outcome-bifurcation frontier, steering rollouts away from absorbed rumination and toward unresolved decision points. Second, it models latent node values with boundary-scaled heteroscedastic edge variances and computes exact global posteriors in linear $\mathcal{O}(|V|)$ time via two-pass Rauch--Tung--Striebel (RTS) tree belief smoothing, eliminating $\mathcal{O}(m^3)$ matrix inversions while gating out spurious boundary noise. Third, BRIAR detects minimal absorbed frontier nodes and applies zero-sum log-length centered suffix advantages strictly post-absorption, leaving pre-absorption derivations provably invariant.
items.abstract_zh: 带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）迅速推进了长链推理，然而标准策略优化器在一条轨迹上盲目分配 rollout 计算和梯度信用。在困难问题上，早期失误会使剩余轨迹脱轨，而在可解问题上，策略在答案已经确定很久之后仍继续生成冗余验证。我们将这两种病态归因于一个结构性事实：在 on-policy 验证器下，沿推理轨迹的真实前缀通过概率 $V^π(u)$ 形成一个取值于 $[0,1]$ 的 Doob 鞅，其可学习信用方差严格守恒，并且上界为 $V^π(u)(1-V^π(u))$，在脱轨边界（$V^π\to 0$）和吸收边界（$V^π\to 1$）处均消失。我们提出 BRIAR（Bifurcation-guided Rollout and Inference on Adaptive Reasoning trees），一个直接围绕该鞅几何构建的树结构 RLVR 框架。首先，BRIAR 沿上置信结果分叉前沿扩展与话语对齐的推理树，将 rollout 从已吸收的反复思考引导向未解决的决策点。其次，它用边界缩放异方差边方差建模潜在节点值，并通过两遍 Rauch--Tung--Striebel（RTS）树信念平滑，在 $\mathcal{O}(|V|)$ 线性时间内计算精确全局后验，消除了 $\mathcal{O}(m^3)$ 矩阵求逆，同时门控掉虚假边界噪声。第三，BRIAR 检测最小吸收前沿节点，并严格在吸收后应用零和、对数长度居中的后缀优势，使吸收前推导可证明保持不变。

items.title_en: Puzzling-Bench: Evaluating Language Models on 23,777 Human-Written Puzzles with Community-Verified Answers
items.title_zh: Puzzling-Bench：在23,777个带有社区验证答案的人类编写谜题上评估语言模型
items.abstract_en: We introduce Puzzling-Bench, a benchmark of 23,777 puzzles with community-verified answers drawn from the Puzzling Stack Exchange archive (2014-2026): riddles, ciphers, logic grids, lateral-thinking problems, wordplay and recreational mathematics, a third of them with images. Every puzzle carries the answer accepted by its author, a short reference answer taken from it (LLM-extracted for the evaluation sets and checked on a 50-puzzle human review), the author's own hints, community tags and a creation date, so that the benchmark supports hint ablations, category analysis and a rolling post-cutoff slice (254 puzzles posted after the training cutoff of six of the nine models we evaluate, including the best one) as a contamination check. We evaluate nine frontier and open models with a two-tier scorer (normalized exact match, then an LLM judge) and validate the judge with three judges from two model families: they agree on 95-97% of verdicts (kappa 0.82-0.96), move no model by more than 1.6 points, and show no own-family preference. The best model, GPT-6.1, reaches 74.8% on a shared 255-puzzle set; a hard core of 17 puzzles defeats all nine models; model failures are strongly correlated, and the second-best model contributes a single puzzle to a greedy ensemble, yet an oracle over all nine reaches 91%. On a 100-puzzle multimodal pilot, withholding the question's image costs the two best models 24 and 35 points. We release the dataset, the scoring pipeline and all per-row provenance.
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出 Puzzling-Bench，一个包含 23,777 个谜题的基准，其答案经社区验证，取自 Puzzling Stack Exchange 档案（2014-2026）：谜语、密码、逻辑网格、横向思维问题、文字游戏和趣味数学，其中三分之一带有图像。每个谜题都带有其作者接受的答案、从中提取的简短参考答案（评估集由 LLM 提取，并在 50 个谜题的人工审查中检查）、作者自己的提示、社区标签和创建日期，因此该基准支持提示消融、类别分析，以及一个滚动的截止后切片（254 个谜题发布于我们所评估九个模型中六个的训练截止之后，包括最好的模型）作为污染检查。我们使用两级评分器（归一化精确匹配，然后 LLM 裁判）评估九个前沿和开放模型，并用来自两个模型家族的三个裁判验证该裁判：它们在 95-97% 的判定上一致（kappa 0.82-0.96），没有模型变动超过 1.6 分，并且没有表现出对本家族的偏好。最佳模型 GPT-6.1 在共享的 255 个谜题集上达到 74.8%；17 个谜题的困难核心击败了所有九个模型；模型失败高度相关，第二好的模型向贪心集成仅贡献一个谜题，而对所有九个模型的 oracle 达到 91%。在一个 100 个谜题的多模态试点中，不提供问题图像使两个最佳模型分别损失 24 和 35 分。我们发布数据集、评分流程以及所有逐行来源信息。

items.title_en: AirLeg: A Robust and Accurate Self-Supervised Visual-Inertial-Leg SLAM System
items.title_zh: AirLeg：一个稳健且准确的自监督视觉-惯性-腿 SLAM 系统
items.abstract_en: Visual-inertial-leg (VIL) state estimation offers cost-effective localization for legged robots, adding only a camera to the onboard IMU and joint encoders. However, learning-based leg odometry is limited by its supervision: networks trained in simulation suffer from the sim-to-real gap, while real-world labels require costly sensors or inherit the errors of visual estimates. To address this, we present AirLeg, a self-supervised VIL SLAM system in which vision and leg proprioception improve each other from training to deployment. We pre-train the leg odometry network in simulation and adapt it to the robot without ground truth through imperative learning, where multi-sensor bundle adjustment uses the leg odometry to refine the visual map, which in turn supervises the network. During deployment, the fused estimates adapt the network online. To improve both localization and this supervision, a dual-window estimator fuses vision, IMU, and leg odometry, relates loaded feet to the visually reconstructed terrain through a deformation-aware constraint, and weights the constraints by variance component estimation. AirLeg completes all 17 GrandTour sequences with the lowest average error (0.19 m) among 19 methods. On a low-cost quadruped, it achieves the lowest drift (0.6%) with only 0.5 h of unlabeled data, in real time on an embedded computer.
items.abstract_zh: 视觉-惯性-腿（VIL）状态估计为腿式机器人提供了具有成本效益的定位，只需在机载 IMU 和关节编码器上添加一个相机。然而，基于学习的腿式里程计受其监督的限制：在仿真中训练的网络存在仿真到现实的差距，而真实世界标签需要昂贵传感器或继承视觉估计的误差。为解决这一问题，我们提出 AirLeg，一个自监督 VIL SLAM 系统，其中视觉和腿部本体感知从训练到部署相互改进。我们在仿真中预训练腿式里程计网络，并通过命令式学习在没有真值的情况下将其适配到机器人，其中多传感器光束法平差使用腿式里程计来优化视觉地图，而视觉地图反过来监督网络。在部署期间，融合估计在线适配网络。为改进定位和这种监督，双窗口估计器融合视觉、IMU 和腿式里程计，通过变形感知约束将受载足与视觉重建地形相关联，并通过方差分量估计对约束加权。AirLeg 完成了全部 17 个 GrandTour 序列，在 19 种方法中平均误差最低（0.19 m）。在低成本四足机器人上，它仅用 0.5 小时无标签数据就实现了最低漂移（0.6%），并在嵌入式计算机上实时运行。

items.title_en: Beyond Feature Fusion: Sensor-Grounded Semantic-Spiking Learning for Robust Object Detection
items.title_zh: 超越特征融合：面向鲁棒目标检测的传感器锚定语义脉冲学习
items.abstract_en: Underexposure weakens object details, and overexposure obscures boundaries. Spike cameras encode light into high-frequency binary streams. Long-window spike counts give stable appearance cues, while short observations reveal changes in firing rates from sparse measurements. We propose SPIRE, a sensor-grounded semantic-spiking framework for illumination-robust object detection from a single spike stream. SPIRE builds an appearance view from the full packet through detection-oriented illumination adaptation and constructs a sequence of cumulative views from progressively longer prefixes. Each prefix supplies a rate map, an edge map, and a rate difference that tracks changes as spikes accumulate. At selected scales, ANN features and spike-derived initialization jointly set the initial membrane potentials and firing thresholds, allowing semantic cues to shape the responses during temporal encoding. Local spike-count contrasts supervise both branches during training. The residual between measured and ANN-predicted contrasts combines with the spiking features to produce a bounded correction to the fused feature pyramid. On simulated VOC and COCO, SPIRE-D outperforms the strongest baseline by 4.00-5.50 AP50 points across the four under- and overexposure settings. On real PKU-Vidar-DVS recordings, it achieves 67.07 AP50 and 40.10 AP75. SPIRE-D also uses 50.4% fewer MACs than SPFD.
items.abstract_zh: 曝光不足会削弱目标细节，过度曝光会模糊边界。脉冲相机将光编码为高频二值流。长窗口脉冲计数提供稳定的外观线索，而短观测从稀疏测量中揭示发放率的变化。我们提出SPIRE，一种传感器锚定的语义脉冲框架，用于从单条脉冲流中进行光照鲁棒的目标检测。SPIRE通过面向检测的光照自适应从完整数据包构建外观视图，并从逐渐增长的前缀构建一系列累积视图。每个前缀提供一个速率图、一个边缘图，以及一个随脉冲累积跟踪变化的速率差。在选定尺度上，ANN特征和脉冲导出的初始化共同设置初始膜电位和发放阈值，使语义线索在时间编码期间塑造响应。局部脉冲计数对比在训练期间监督两个分支。测量对比度与ANN预测对比度之间的残差与脉冲特征结合，对融合特征金字塔产生有界校正。在模拟VOC和COCO上，SPIRE-D在四种曝光不足和过度曝光设置下以4.00-5.50个AP50点优于最强基线。在真实PKU-Vidar-DVS记录上，它达到67.07 AP50和40.10 AP75。SPIRE-D使用的MACs也比SPFD少50.4%。

items.title_en: Benchmarking Protein Structure Tokenizers as Generation Targets for Language Models
items.title_zh: 蛋白质结构分词器作为语言模型生成目标的基准评测
items.abstract_en: Discrete structure tokenizers are the standard way to give a language model access to protein three-dimensional structure, yet they are selected on how accurately they can be read, their reconstruction fidelity, while the property that governs generation is how well a model can write them. We measure this property, writability, directly: holding the base model, data, recipe and compute fixed, we swap only the tokenizer and train the same 9B model to emit structure tokens residue by residue, over eight tokenizers, four compute budgets and three evaluation sets (96 cells). At 2B tokens final writability runs from TM 0.662 down to 0.378 under identical conditions, with five of the eight arms clearing the TM 0.5 mark at which a fold is usually called correct and three falling short of it. Neither codebook size nor reconstruction ceiling explains where an arm lands; the best and worst both use 8192 codewords. What does explain the spread is local structure preservation of the code space. In DPLM-2 a one-bit codeword error costs 0.019 TM where a random codeword costs 0.347, and the trained model's own errors are correspondingly local, at 0.51 of the random Hamming expectation; FoldToken4 fails both tests at the same codebook size and is 0.13 TM less writable. Three controls discipline how such a benchmark may be read. A same-recipe rerun puts the noise floor at $σ=0.0067$ TM, which collapses an apparent six-way ranking into four tiers. A reference-free geometry panel turns out to be nearly orthogonal to TM (Pearson $-0.58$), with the worst arm by TM producing the most physically valid backbones. And two pre-registered interventions are null for a reason the mechanism measurements reveal: the quantity they target saturates at 1.5B tokens while TM is still rising. All 131 evaluation cells, including raw generated token streams, are released.
items.abstract_zh: 离散结构分词器是让语言模型访问蛋白质三维结构的标准方式，然而它们是根据可被读取的准确程度（即重建保真度）来选择的，而支配生成的属性是模型能够多好地写出它们。我们直接测量这一属性，即可写性：在固定基础模型、数据、配方和计算的情况下，只替换分词器，训练同一个9B模型逐残基地输出结构标记，覆盖八种分词器、四种计算预算和三个评估集（96个评估单元）。在2B tokens时，相同条件下最终可写性从TM 0.662降至0.378，八个分支中有五个超过TM 0.5标记（通常认为折叠正确），三个未达到。码本大小和重建上限都不能解释分支所处的位置；最好和最差的分支都使用8192个码字。能解释这种差异的是码空间的局部结构保持。在DPLM-2中，一位码字错误造成0.019 TM的代价，而随机码字造成0.347的代价，训练模型自身的错误相应是局部的，为随机汉明期望的0.51；FoldToken4在相同码本大小下两项测试均失败，可写性低0.13 TM。三项对照规范了如何解读这样的基准。相同配方的重跑将噪声底限设为$σ=0.0067$ TM，这将一个看似六路排名压缩为四个层级。一个无参考的几何面板结果与TM几乎正交（Pearson $-0.58$），按TM最差的分支反而产生物理上最有效的骨架。两项预注册干预无效，原因由机制测量揭示：它们所针对的量在1.5B tokens时饱和，而TM仍在上升。所有131个评估单元，包括原始生成的标记流，均已发布。

items.title_en: High-Dimensional Single-Photon Frequency Conversion for Orbital Angular Momentum Comb State
items.title_zh: 轨道角动量梳态的高维单光子频率转换
items.abstract_en: The orbital angular momentum (OAM) degree of freedom provides an important resource for constructing high-dimensional optical quantum information systems. However, the generation of high-dimensional single-photon OAM comb state and its high-fidelity frequency conversion remain challenging due to limited spatial modulation resolution, imperfect mode matching, and finite nonlinear conversion efficiency. Here, we proposed and experimentally demonstrated a scalable scheme for the generation and frequency conversion of high-dimensional single-photon OAM comb state. We prepared a single-photon OAM comb state with a dimension of up to 128, achieving a fidelity of 0.787 between the reconstructed and target states and an effective dimension of 100. Furthermore, using the sum-frequency generation, we demonstrated the frequency upconversion of single-photon high-dimensional OAM comb state from the communication band to a visible wavelength of 520 nm, while verifying the preservation of both the OAM mode distribution and phase information through density matrix reconstruction. Our work established a versatile platform for the generation, manipulation, and characterization of high-dimensional OAM comb states, with potential applications in cross-band quantum information transfer, high-capacity quantum communication, and high-dimensional quantum networks.
items.abstract_zh: 轨道角动量（OAM）自由度为构建高维光学量子信息系统提供了重要资源。然而，由于空间调制分辨率有限、模式匹配不完美以及非线性转换效率有限，高维单光子OAM梳态的生成及其高保真频率转换仍然具有挑战性。在此，我们提出并通过实验演示了一种可扩展方案，用于高维单光子OAM梳态的生成和频率转换。我们制备了维度高达128的单光子OAM梳态，在重建态与目标态之间达到0.787的保真度，有效维度为100。此外，利用和频产生，我们演示了单光子高维OAM梳态从通信波段到520 nm可见光波长的频率上转换，同时通过密度矩阵重建验证了OAM模式分布和相位信息的保持。我们的工作建立了一个用于高维OAM梳态生成、操控和表征的多功能平台，在跨波段量子信息传输、大容量量子通信和高维量子网络方面具有潜在应用。

items.title_en: Decision-Aligned Value Learning for Selective Adoption of EEG Fusion in Human-Robot Collaboration
items.title_zh: 人-机器人协作中EEG融合选择性采纳的决策对齐价值学习
items.abstract_en: Electroencephalography (EEG) captures neural activity associated with human perception and decision-making. It provides human-robot collaboration (HRC) systems with measurable evidence for event recognition, situation assessment, and action preparation. External sensing cannot easily provide such evidence. However, the quality and complementarity of this evidence vary across samples, and existing EEG fusion methods do not explicitly determine when EEG improves a prediction. We therefore framed selective EEG use as a sample-wise incremental-value estimation problem and proposed Value Estimation and Constraint-Aware Triage for Adoption (VECTA). VECTA separates the generation of an EEG-informed Fusion prediction from the decision about whether it should replace the existing Base prediction. The framework uses system gain to quantify the loss reduction from Base to Fusion and matching gain to assess whether benefits arise from sample-matched EEG. A signed-value learner estimates system gain from decision-time evidence and prioritizes high-value Fusion outputs under budget constraints. Cross-subject evaluations on three HRC datasets showed that matched Fusion outperformed shuffled controls. Estimated gains tracked realized gains, with Spearman correlations of 0.347-0.612 and positive-gain areas under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROCs) of 0.708-0.842. Under budget constraints, VECTA reduced Brier loss and harmful Fusion adoption and achieved the highest mean normalized AUBC across three datasets among the selective-decision methods evaluated. Validation on three external multi-modal datasets showed that VECTA could be applied directly as a post-hoc decision layer to task-specific predictors without retraining. These results show that selective Fusion adoption can translate the uneven utility of EEG into system-level gains.
items.abstract_zh: 脑电图（EEG）捕获与人类感知和决策相关的神经活动。它为人-机器人协作（HRC）系统提供用于事件识别、态势评估和动作准备的可测量证据。外部传感无法轻易提供此类证据。然而，这种证据的质量和互补性因样本而异，现有EEG融合方法并未明确确定EEG何时改善预测。因此，我们将选择性EEG使用框定为样本级增量价值估计问题，并提出价值估计与约束感知采纳分诊（VECTA）。VECTA将生成EEG信息引导的Fusion预测与关于其是否应替换现有Base预测的决策分开。该框架使用系统增益来量化从Base到Fusion的损失降低，并使用匹配增益来评估收益是否来自样本匹配的EEG。一个带符号价值学习器从决策时证据估计系统增益，并在预算约束下优先考虑高价值Fusion输出。在三个HRC数据集上的跨被试评估显示，匹配的Fusion优于打乱对照。估计增益跟踪实现增益，Spearman相关系数为0.347-0.612，正增益的受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUROC）为0.708-0.842。在预算约束下，VECTA降低了Brier损失和有害的Fusion采纳，并在所评估的选择性决策方法中，在三个数据集上取得最高的平均归一化AUBC。在三个外部多模态数据集上的验证表明，VECTA可以直接作为事后决策层应用于任务特定预测器，而无需重新训练。这些结果表明，选择性Fusion采纳可以将EEG的不均匀效用转化为系统级收益。

items.title_en: Repairing the Trustworthiness of Distilled Language Models
items.title_zh: 修复蒸馏语言模型的可信性
items.abstract_en: Knowledge distillation enables the deployment of large language models through smaller student models, but the compression process can introduce regressions in trustworthiness even when downstream performance is preserved. Repairing such failures is challenging because the original distillation corpus is often unavailable, while direct preference optimization may alter capabilities inherited from the teacher. We propose a targeted repair framework based on the proximal Bregman response function (PBRF) that addresses both limitations. We estimate the curvature required for PBRF using a surrogate proxy dataset, removing dependence on the original transfer corpus, and extend the framework to preference-based supervision through an odds-ratio objective. This enables the use of preferred and dispreferred response pairs while constraining changes to the distilled model. Our results show that the proposed approach improves targeted trustworthiness behaviors for both pre-training and post-training models while largely preserving downstream performance, providing a practical alternative to re-distillation or unconstrained preference optimization. Our experiment results show that across different distilled models, the trustworthy regression can be improved by up to 8% with less than 1% decrement in perplexity.
items.abstract_zh: 知识蒸馏通过较小的学生模型实现大语言模型的部署，但压缩过程即使在保留下游性能时也可能引入可信性退化。修复此类失败具有挑战性，因为原始蒸馏语料库通常不可用，而直接偏好优化可能改变从教师模型继承的能力。我们提出一种基于近端Bregman响应函数（PBRF）的目标修复框架，解决这两个限制。我们使用替代代理数据集估计PBRF所需的曲率，消除对原始迁移语料库的依赖，并通过优势比目标将框架扩展到基于偏好的监督。这使得能够使用偏好和不偏好响应对，同时约束对蒸馏模型的改变。我们的结果表明，所提方法改善了预训练和后训练模型的目标可信性行为，同时很大程度上保留下游性能，为重新蒸馏或无约束偏好优化提供了实用替代方案。我们的实验结果表明，在不同蒸馏模型上，可信性回归可提升最多8%，困惑度下降不到1%。

items.title_en: iMFPO: Improving Mean Flow Policy Optimization with Drift-Aware Velocity Alignment for Embodied Control
items.title_zh: iMFPO：通过漂移感知速度对齐改进用于具身控制的平均流策略优化
items.abstract_en: Flow-based generative policies offer expressive action modeling for embodied control, yet achieving efficient one-step generation under reward-driven policy optimization remains challenging. In particular, evolving action distributions during online reinforcement learning may introduce inconsistencies between instantaneous-velocity learning and interval-averaged action generation. To address this challenge, we propose iMFPO, a one-step generative policy optimization framework with decoupled velocity learning and drift-aware velocity alignment. A shared interval-conditioned actor supports instantaneous-velocity supervision and interval-averaged action generation. JVP-corrected velocity regression is jointly optimized with reward-driven policy objectives, with action-level guidance from a frozen PPO teacher during training. At inference, iMFPO directly generates actions through interval-averaged velocity prediction, achieving one-step control without iterative flow integration. Across Go2, G1, H1, and Spot, zero-latent evaluation yields mean returns of 35.69, 34.44, 416.23, and 29.86. On Go2, action-generation latency drops from 15.57 ms to 0.41 ms relative to 64-step RFPO. Code: https://github.com/AIGeeksGroup/iMFPO. Website: https://aigeeksgroup.github.io/iMFPO.
items.abstract_zh: 基于流的生成策略为具身控制提供了富有表现力的动作建模，然而在奖励驱动的策略优化下实现高效的一步生成仍然具有挑战性。特别是，在线强化学习期间动作分布的演化可能引入瞬时速度学习与区间平均动作生成之间的不一致。为应对这一挑战，我们提出iMFPO，一种具有解耦速度学习和漂移感知速度对齐的一步生成策略优化框架。一个共享的区间条件演员支持瞬时速度监督和区间平均动作生成。JVP校正的速度回归与奖励驱动的策略目标联合优化，训练期间由冻结的PPO教师提供动作级指导。在推理时，iMFPO通过区间平均速度预测直接生成动作，实现无需迭代流积分的一步控制。在Go2、G1、H1和Spot上，零潜变量评估产生平均回报35.69、34.44、416.23和29.86。在Go2上，相对于64步RFPO，动作生成延迟从15.57 ms降至0.41 ms。代码：https://github.com/AIGeeksGroup/iMFPO。网站：https://aigeeksgroup.github.io/iMFPO。

items.title_en: AnyCam: Anything Can Represent Camera for Video Generation
items.title_zh: AnyCam：任何事物都可以表示相机以生成视频
items.abstract_en: Camera-controlled video generation re-renders a video along a target camera trajectory, yet moving the camera around an object, the most natural way to change the viewpoint of an object-centric scene, remains difficult. Existing methods condition either on camera parameters, which are scale-ambiguous in monocular video, or on explicit geometry such as warped point clouds or depth, which breaks down under large viewpoint changes. We present AnyCam, a method that represents the camera with an anchor object in the scene: we reconstruct it in 3D and render it along the target trajectory, a camera signal that is scale-aware, view-complete and easy to specify relative to the object. A video diffusion model transfers the content and dynamics of the source video to the new viewpoint. Its H-Concat layout aligns source and target frames in time, so the model can be distilled into AnyCam-AR, a streaming few-step generator for on-the-fly camera control. Both models are trained on paired videos with pixel-aligned anchor renderings from multi-camera videos and static-scene captures. Experiments on diverse datasets and trajectories show that AnyCam performs favorably against camera-controlled video generation and 3D reconstruction methods in camera control and visual quality.
items.abstract_zh: 相机控制的视频生成沿目标相机轨迹重新渲染视频，然而围绕物体移动相机——改变以物体为中心场景视角的最自然方式——仍然困难。现有方法或以相机参数为条件，而相机参数在单目视频中具有尺度歧义，或以显式几何（如变形点云或深度）为条件，而后者在大视角变化下会失效。我们提出 AnyCam，一种用场景中的锚定物体来表示相机的方法：我们在 3D 中重建该物体并沿目标轨迹渲染它，这种相机信号具有尺度感知、视角完整且易于相对于物体指定。视频扩散模型将源视频的内容和动态迁移到新视角。其 H-Concat 布局在时间上对齐源帧和目标帧，因此该模型可以蒸馏为 AnyCam-AR，一种用于即时相机控制的流式少步生成器。两个模型均在配对视频上训练，这些视频带有来自多相机视频和静态场景捕获的像素对齐锚定渲染。在不同数据集和轨迹上的实验表明，AnyCam 在相机控制和视觉质量方面优于相机控制的视频生成和 3D 重建方法。

items.title_en: LeCellModel: Interpretable Density Estimation over the Gene Expression Manifold
items.title_zh: LeCellModel：基因表达流形上的可解释密度估计
items.abstract_en: Representation learning for single-cell RNA-seq has been evaluated by the identities representations capture -- cell types, lineages, perturbations -- rather than how faithfully they model the distribution of cell states on the gene expression manifold. As a result, density estimation, rare-state detection, perturbation scoring, and gene-level attribution are bolted onto frozen embeddings as separate models, disconnected from the geometry of the data. We argue that modeling the distribution of cell states should be the primary objective, and that representation quality follows from it. Building on LeJEPA, whose SIGReg objective enforces a provably optimal isotropic Gaussian latent, we introduce LeCellModel, which reads the encoder's Jacobian log-volume (JEPA-SCORE) under this Gaussian latent as a relative typicality score. Across several datasets, LeCellModel outperforms established methods on the scIB benchmark for representation quality. Furthermore, we show that LeCellModel enables detection of rare expression states using JEPA-SCORE as a typicality measure, applying it to a controlled cytokine panel, where it identifies stimulated cells across minority fractions and tracks pathway-response magnitude. We introduce gene-level interpretability of the typicality score -- to our knowledge, the first method for analyzing JEPA-SCORE in feature space. Leveraging this framework, LeCellModel recapitulates the known association of a profibrotic macrophage program with idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis, and discovers a CD177+ activated regulatory T cell subpopulation previously described only in tumor contexts. Both findings emerge directly from the geometry of the learned embedding, without relying on supervised annotations.
items.abstract_zh: 单细胞 RNA-seq 的表示学习一直依据表示所捕获的身份——细胞类型、谱系、扰动——来评估，而不是依据它们在基因表达流形上对细胞状态分布的建模忠实程度。因此，密度估计、稀有状态检测、扰动评分和基因级归因被作为独立模型附加到冻结嵌入上，与数据的几何结构脱节。我们主张，建模细胞状态的分布应成为主要目标，而表示质量由此派生。基于 LeJEPA（其 SIGReg 目标强制得到可证明最优的各向同性高斯潜变量），我们提出 LeCellModel，它将该高斯潜变量下编码器的雅可比对数体积（JEPA-SCORE）解读为相对典型性分数。在多个数据集上，LeCellModel 在 scIB 表示质量基准上优于已有方法。此外，我们表明 LeCellModel 能够使用 JEPA-SCORE 作为典型性度量来检测稀有表达状态，并将其应用于受控细胞因子 panel，在该 panel 中它跨少数比例识别受刺激细胞并追踪通路响应幅度。我们引入了典型性分数的基因级可解释性——据我们所知，这是首个在特征空间中分析 JEPA-SCORE 的方法。利用该框架，LeCellModel 重现了促纤维化巨噬细胞程序与特发性肺纤维化的已知关联，并发现了此前仅在肿瘤背景中描述过的 CD177+ 活化调节性 T 细胞亚群。两项发现均直接源自所学嵌入的几何结构，而不依赖监督标注。

items.title_en: Packing the Bragg sphere: complete three-dimensional photonic band gaps at the refractive index of polymers (1.55)
items.title_zh: 填充布拉格球：在聚合物折射率（1.55）下实现完整三维光子带隙
items.abstract_en: Complete 3D photonic band gaps have so far been found only at refractive-index contrasts of about 1.9 and above, reached by rod-connected diamond lattice structures. Reciprocal-space design of quasiperiodic structures recently achieved considerable emission attenuation at much lower contrasts [L. Maiwald et al., Adv. Optical Mater. 10, 2100785 (2022)]. Here we implement systematic search and reciprocal-space design of periodic 3D structures with complete band gaps, solving a discrete optimization problem on an integer lattice. A gap above a high band needs the strongest Fourier components of the dielectric close to the Bragg sphere of that band. Crystals with large cells, started from Fourier peaks at the vertices of a polyhedron on this sphere and optimized against densely refined band edges, open complete gaps down to an index contrast of 1.55, that of common polymers against air. A rational approximant of an icosidodecahedron gave the most efficient location of the Fourier peaks among the polyhedra tested. Numerical calculations confirm the gaps over a resolution series, with band edges searched over the whole Brillouin zone. The best designs are connected porous networks, suited to a microwave test with printed polymer. A rigorous bound, valid for any structure, does not exclude gaps at lower index, and the next rational approximants of the icosidodecahedron, whose Bragg zones match bands 576 and 2440 almost exactly, point to where gaps at even lower contrast may be sought.
items.abstract_zh: 迄今为止，完整三维光子带隙仅在约 1.9 及以上的折射率对比度下被发现，这些带隙由杆连接的钻石晶格结构实现。准周期结构的倒空间设计最近在低得多的对比度下实现了可观的发射衰减 [L. Maiwald et al., Adv. Optical Mater. 10, 2100785 (2022)]。在此，我们实施对具有完整带隙的周期性三维结构的系统搜索与倒空间设计，求解整数格点上的离散优化问题。高能带之上的带隙需要介电常数最强的傅里叶分量靠近该能带的布拉格球。大晶胞晶体从该球面上多面体顶点处的傅里叶峰出发，并针对密集细化的带边进行优化，可将完整带隙打开至折射率对比度低至 1.55，即常见聚合物相对于空气的对比度。在测试的多面体中，二十面十二面体的有理逼近给出了傅里叶峰的最有效位置。数值计算在一系列分辨率上确认了带隙，带边在整个布里渊区搜索。最佳设计是连通多孔网络，适用于印刷聚合物的微波测试。一个对任意结构均成立的严格界并不排除更低折射率下的带隙，而二十面十二面体的后续有理逼近（其布拉格区几乎精确匹配第 576 和 2440 能带）指出了可能在何处寻找更低对比度下的带隙。

items.title_en: A Real-Time Low-Cost Platform for Non-Contact Respiratory Rate Monitoring: A Comparative Evaluation of RGB Optical Flow and Time-of-Flight Depth Sensing
items.title_zh: 用于非接触呼吸率监测的实时低成本平台：RGB 光流与飞行时间深度传感的比较评估
items.abstract_en: Respiratory rate (RR) is one of the earliest indicators of clinical deterioration, which makes its continuous measurement clinically valuable. In routine practice, however, RR is monitored almost exclusively with contact-based sensors, which require skin attachment, may alter natural breathing, and are poorly tolerated by vulnerable groups such as newborns and elderly patients. Non-contact sensing removes these constraints, with RGB video and depth imaging among its most accessible modalities. In this work, we present a low-cost, real-time platform based on a single multimodal sensor that provides both RGB and time-of-flight (ToF) data streams, implemented on a Raspberry Pi 5 edge device. The system integrates three RGB optical-flow pipelines, namely Farnebäck, Horn--Schunck, and Lucas--Kanade, together with a depth-based pipeline incorporating region-of-interest stabilization and distance-derived signal extraction, enabling the two modalities to be evaluated independently under the same experimental protocol. The proposed approach was evaluated on twelve healthy volunteers following a controlled protocol, including normal breathing, hyperventilation, and breath-holding, using a piezoresistive respiratory belt as a reference. RGB-based methods achieved lower RR estimation errors, with Lucas--Kanade attaining the lowest median MAE (3.83 BPM), whereas the ToF-based pipeline, although less accurate for RR estimation (median MAE 6.24 BPM), reached a higher apnea detection sensitivity (0.66 vs 0.51-0.55). These findings highlight the complementary strengths of both modalities and support their integration into unified low-cost platforms.
items.abstract_zh: 呼吸率（RR）是临床恶化的最早指标之一，因此其连续测量具有临床价值。然而在常规实践中，RR 几乎完全通过接触式传感器监测，这些传感器需要贴附皮肤，可能改变自然呼吸，并且新生儿和老年患者等脆弱群体的耐受性较差。非接触传感消除了这些限制，其中 RGB 视频和深度成像是其最易获取的模态之一。在这项工作中，我们提出一个基于单一多模态传感器的低成本实时平台，该传感器同时提供 RGB 和飞行时间（ToF）数据流，并实现在 Raspberry Pi 5 边缘设备上。系统集成了三条 RGB 光流管线，即 Farnebäck、Horn--Schunck 和 Lucas--Kanade，以及一条基于深度的管线，后者包含感兴趣区域稳定和距离导出信号提取，使得两种模态能够在相同实验方案下独立评估。所提方法在十二名健康志愿者上按照受控方案进行评估，包括正常呼吸、过度通气和屏气，并使用压阻式呼吸带作为参考。基于 RGB 的方法取得了更低的 RR 估计误差，其中 Lucas--Kanade 达到最低的中位 MAE（3.83 BPM），而基于 ToF 的管线虽然在 RR 估计上精度较低（中位 MAE 6.24 BPM），但达到了更高的呼吸暂停检测灵敏度（0.66 对 0.51-0.55）。这些发现凸显了两种模态的互补优势，并支持将它们集成到统一的低成本平台中。

items.title_en: Technical Report MEG2text: Beyond Alignment in Non-Invasive Brain-to-Text
items.title_zh: 技术报告 MEG2text：非侵入式脑到文本中超越对齐
items.abstract_en: Non-invasive brain-to-text seeks to recover language from brain activity without surgery. A central challenge is turning learned brain-language representations into accurate word predictions. We present MEG2text, a decoding system that combines corrected training and evaluation, brain-text alignment, a class-balanced word readout, and target-word language-model fusion. On LibriBrain100's word-ranking task, MEG2text reaches 64.12% mean Top-10 balanced accuracy, improving on published MEG-XL by 16.92 percentage points across four corpora, with gains on each corpus. Controlled comparisons show that both implementation corrections and a learned readout contribute to this improvement. Candidate-level analysis reveals that some words receive informative scores yet consistently lose to competing candidates, while an identical-feature comparison shows that learning the classification rule improves decoding without changing the representation. These findings identify the decoding rule as a consequential part of non-invasive brain-to-text and show how system improvements can make better use of aligned neural features.
items.abstract_zh: 非侵入式脑到文本旨在无需手术即可从脑活动中恢复语言。一个核心挑战是将学习到的脑-语言表示转化为准确的词预测。我们提出 MEG2text，一种解码系统，它结合了校正后的训练与评估、脑-文本对齐、类别平衡的词读出以及目标词语言模型融合。在 LibriBrain100 的词排序任务上，MEG2text 达到 64.12% 的平均 Top-10 平衡准确率，在四个语料上相较已发表的 MEG-XL 提升 16.92 个百分点，并在每个语料上均有增益。受控比较表明，实现校正和学习到的读出均对这项改进有贡献。候选级分析揭示，一些词获得有信息量的分数却始终输给竞争候选，而相同特征比较表明，学习分类规则可在不改变表示的情况下改进解码。这些发现将解码规则确定为非侵入式脑到文本中的关键部分，并展示了系统改进如何能更好地利用对齐的神经特征。
