items.title_en: RePace: Reasoning about Demonstration Speedup for Faster Vision-Language-Action Policies
items.title_zh: RePace：推理演示加速以得到更快的视觉-语言-动作策略
items.abstract_en: Since vision-language-action (VLA) policies can inherit the slow pace of human demonstrations, accelerating these demonstrations before fine-tuning can lead to faster VLA policies without an additional speed-selection module at deployment. Several offline speedup methods have focused on identifying segments that require less precision and assigning predefined speedup factors to the segments. However, even within a single segment, a speedup factor suitable for steady motion may be too high when precise alignment is required. To this end, this paper presents RePace, an offline reasoning framework that determines how much to accelerate each part of a demonstration. For the same recorded movement, RePace measures how much each candidate speedup factor shortens the sequence and compares the resulting observation-action pairs used for training. Given the task instruction, a pretrained language model uses the visual context and original motion of successive windows to interpret these candidate retiming effects and select a speedup profile for the complete episode. Experimental results demonstrate that RePace outperforms the baselines in overall task execution efficiency on both LIBERO and RoboCasa-Kitchen. On all three tasks with a gripper-equipped Franka Research 3 arm, RePace matches or exceeds the acceleration baselines in success rate and completes successful trials faster.
items.abstract_zh: 由于视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略可能继承人类演示的缓慢节奏，在微调之前加速这些演示可以产生更快的 VLA 策略，而无需在部署时添加额外的速度选择模块。若干离线加速方法侧重于识别需要较少精度的片段，并为这些片段分配预定义加速因子。然而，即使在单个片段内，适合稳定运动的加速因子在需要精确对齐时也可能过高。为此，本文提出 RePace，一个离线推理框架，用于确定对演示的每个部分加速多少。对于同一段记录运动，RePace 测量每个候选加速因子能缩短序列多少，并比较由此产生的用于训练的观测-动作对。给定任务指令，预训练语言模型利用连续窗口的视觉上下文和原始运动来解释这些候选重定时效果，并为完整回合选择加速配置。实验结果表明，RePace 在 LIBERO 和 RoboCasa-Kitchen 上的整体任务执行效率均优于基线。在配备夹爪的 Franka Research 3 机械臂上的全部三项任务中，RePace 在成功率上达到或超过加速基线，并更快完成成功试验。

items.title_en: Fewer Fractions, Equieffective Plans: An optimization framework based on equieffective dose
items.title_zh: 更少分次，等效计划：一种基于等效剂量的优化框架
items.abstract_en: Background: Non-standard fractionation requires caution before clinical use, and planners often need to manually modify the prescription and dose constraints for non-linear biological effects. Purpose: To develop an extension within a treatment planning system that enables the generation of hypofractionated plans based on equieffective dose, $EQD_{n_{ref}}$, for an alternative fractionation deliverable in $n$ fractions, such that it is equieffective with the reference fractionation for a specified biological endpoint. Methods: A research build of RayStation v2025 was extended to optimize $EQD_{n_{ref}}$ plans. This study used anonymized data from three head and neck patients. $\text{CTV}_p$ and $\text{CTV}_n$ were prescribed 70 Gy and 54 Gy in 35 fractions. Targets, spinal cord, and brainstem were robustly optimized for $\pm3.5$% density and $\pm3.0$ mm setup uncertainties. For each patient, hypofractionated plans were created with 34, 32, 30, and 25 fractions. Sensitivity analysis evaluated the impact of $α/β$ uncertainty. Results: All equieffective hypofractionated plans maintained target coverage and met mandatory clinical goals for organs-at-risk (OARs). Compared to standard fractionation, DVH parameters indicated an average $ΔEQD_{n_{ref}}$ <0.2 Gy for $\text{CTV}_p$ and no difference for $\text{CTV}_n$. For parallel OARs, the median mean-dose difference between hypofractionation (to 30 fractions) and standard fractionation was generally <1% of the prescribed dose. $α/β$ uncertainty produced the greatest variation in the 25-fraction regimen, with absolute $ΔEQD_{n_{ref}}$ up to 0.88 Gy for targets and up to 0.63 Gy for the spinal cord and brainstem. Conclusions: An $EQD_{n_{ref}}$-based framework can generate equieffective hypofractionated plans, making it feasible to reduce fractions without substantially deviating from existing clinical protocols.
items.abstract_zh: 背景：非常规分次在临床使用前需要谨慎，计划设计者通常需要针对非线性生物学效应手动修改处方和剂量约束。目的：在治疗计划系统内开发一个扩展，使其能够基于等效剂量 EQD_nref 生成大分次计划，用于以 n 次分次实施的替代分次方案，从而在指定生物学终点上与参考分次方案等效。方法：扩展了 RayStation v2025 的研究版本以优化 EQD_nref 计划。本研究使用三名头颈部患者的匿名数据。CTV_p 和 CTV_n 的处方剂量分别为 35 次 70 Gy 和 54 Gy。靶区、脊髓和脑干针对 ±3.5% 密度和 ±3.0 mm 摆位不确定性进行了稳健优化。为每名患者创建了 34、32、30 和 25 次的大分次计划。敏感性分析评估了 α/β 不确定性的影响。结果：所有等效大分次计划均保持了靶区覆盖，并满足危及器官（OAR）的强制性临床目标。与标准分次相比，DVH 参数显示 CTV_p 的平均 ΔEQD_nref <0.2 Gy，CTV_n 无差异。对于并行 OAR，大分次（至 30 次）与标准分次之间的中位平均剂量差异一般 <处方剂量的 1%。α/β 不确定性在 25 次方案中产生最大变化，靶区的绝对 ΔEQD_nref 高达 0.88 Gy，脊髓和脑干高达 0.63 Gy。结论：基于 EQD_nref 的框架能够生成等效大分次计划，使得在不大幅偏离现有临床方案的情况下减少分次成为可行。

items.title_en: Active sensing as control over sensory acquisition
items.title_zh: 主动感知作为对感觉获取的控制
items.abstract_en: The term "active sensing" is used across neuroscience and engineering to describe a wide range of sensing behaviors, but there is no consensus on what makes sensing "active." We propose that the behaviors grouped under this label are better understood as forms of control over sensory acquisition and develop a framework that distinguishes three interacting forms of control. Mechanistic control physically structures sensory input, strategic control modulates sensing in closed loop through adaptive and attentional processes, and agentic control concerns the sensing policies available to an agent and its authority to choose among them. These forms of control can occur separately or in combination, and have distinct consequences for sensory input, perception, behavior, and performance. The framework clarifies active-passive comparisons and provides a common basis for analyzing biological, engineered, and hybrid sensing systems by asking what is controlled, how, and by whom.
items.abstract_zh: “主动感知”一词在神经科学和工程学中被用来描述广泛的感知行为，但关于什么使感知成为“主动”尚无共识。我们提出，归入这一标签的行为最好被理解为对感觉获取的控制形式，并构建了一个框架，区分三种相互作用的控制形式。机制性控制在物理上构建感觉输入，策略性控制通过自适应和注意过程以闭环方式调节感知，而能动性控制涉及智能体可用的感知策略及其在这些策略中进行选择的权限。这些控制形式可以单独出现或组合出现，并对感觉输入、知觉、行为和表现产生不同后果。该框架澄清了主动—被动比较，并通过询问控制什么、如何控制以及由谁控制，为分析生物、工程和混合感知系统提供了共同基础。

items.title_en: Dynamic tuning of anisotropy-induced quasi-bound-states-in-the-continuum in liquid-crystal integrated dielectric metasurfaces
items.title_zh: 液晶集成介质超表面中各向异性诱导连续域准束缚态的动态调谐
items.abstract_en: Symmetry-protected quasi-bound states in the continuum (qBICs) in all-dielectric metasurfaces can be excited either by introducing a geometrical asymmetry into the unit cell or by illuminating the metasurface under oblique incidence. To date, tuning the coupling strength of such qBICs to the continuum has mainly relied on control of the geometrical asymmetry. Here, we show that qBICs can also be induced in a symmetric dielectric metasurface by embedding the latter into an anisotropic birefringent medium, and that they can be actively tuned by either rotating the anisotropy axis of the medium or by varying the degree of anisotropy. We experimentally implement a corresponding system by embedding a highly symmetric silicon nanocylinder metasurface into a nematic liquid crystal (LC) cell. Importantly, the LC does not only provide the desired birefringence, but also dynamic control of its strength as well as of the orientation of its anisotropy axis in response to different external stimuli. Specifically, applying voltage across the LC cell, where the LC molecules are pre-aligned along one of the lattice directions of the metasurface, enables out-of-plane rotation of the anisotropy axis of the LC medium. Meanwhile, its birefringence can be tuned by changing the temperature. In our experiments, the coupling of the qBICs to the radiation continuum is first maximized by the application of 25 V across the LC cell at room temperature. We then systematically tune the temperature and show that the resonance depth of the qBIC modes, which is associated with their coupling strength to the continuum, of the qBIC modes increases monotonously with birefringence. Our findings establish anisotropy-induced qBICs in LC integrated dielectric metasurfaces as a promising platform for actively reconfigurable metasurfaces and their applications in displays, optical modulation and tunable photonic devices.
items.abstract_zh: 全介质超表面中对称保护的连续域准束缚态（qBIC）可通过在晶胞中引入几何不对称性或通过斜入射照明超表面来激发。迄今为止，调节此类 qBIC 与连续域的耦合强度主要依赖于对几何不对称性的控制。在此，我们表明，通过将对称介质超表面嵌入各向异性双折射介质中，也可以在该超表面中诱导 qBIC，并且可通过旋转介质的各向异性轴或改变各向异性程度来主动调谐它们。我们通过将高度对称的硅纳米圆柱超表面嵌入向列相液晶（LC）盒中，实验实现了相应系统。重要的是，LC 不仅提供所需双折射，还能响应不同外部刺激动态控制其强度以及其各向异性轴取向。具体而言，在 LC 分子沿超表面某一晶格方向预排列的 LC 盒上施加电压，可实现 LC 介质各向异性轴的面外旋转。同时，其双折射可通过改变温度来调谐。在我们的实验中，首先通过在室温下于 LC 盒上施加 25 V 使 qBIC 与辐射连续域的耦合最大化。随后我们系统调节温度，并表明 qBIC 模式的共振深度（与其到连续域的耦合强度相关）随双折射单调增加。我们的发现确立了液晶集成介质超表面中的各向异性诱导 qBIC 作为主动可重构超表面及其在显示器、光调制和可调谐光子器件中应用的有前景平台。

items.title_en: Decoupling the clocks of learning and computing in spiking neural networks
items.title_zh: 在脉冲神经网络中解耦学习时钟与计算时钟
items.abstract_en: Biological intelligence thrives on minimal power despite its noisy, imperfect components, with neurons that communicate through voltage spikes. Brain-inspired computing seeks to bring such efficiency to real devices, which requires training methods tailored to them. The standard way to train spiking neural networks, backpropagation through time, computes weight updates through every step of a simulated device, so faithful or long simulations can make training costly and unstable. Here we show that spiking networks can learn reliably and efficiently by decoupling the clock of learning from that of computing. Our method, ChronoProp, calculates weight updates from each neuron's spike counts in fixed time bins using its measured input-output function. Compared with backpropagation through time, ChronoProp reaches similar accuracy in image classification, with about 3 times less training time and 20 times less memory at the finest timestep tested, and up to 10 times fewer spikes. On spoken-word benchmarks, ChronoProp is far more accurate in recurrent networks at fine timesteps, and with simple, hardware-compatible techniques it approaches the best published models. These networks also tolerate simulated hardware defects and limitations better than those trained with backpropagation through time. Therefore, ChronoProp enables stable and efficient training in simulations close to the continuous time of analog hardware.
items.abstract_zh: 生物智能尽管由噪声大、不完美的组件构成，却能以极低功耗繁荣发展，其神经元通过电压脉冲通信。类脑计算旨在将这种效率带到真实设备中，这需要为其量身定制的训练方法。训练脉冲神经网络的标准方法——随时间反向传播——在模拟设备的每一步中计算权重更新，因此高保真或长时间仿真会使训练昂贵且不稳定。在此我们表明，通过将学习时钟与计算时钟解耦，脉冲网络可以可靠且高效地学习。我们的方法 ChronoProp 利用每个神经元测得的输入-输出函数，根据其在固定时间箱中的脉冲计数计算权重更新。与随时间反向传播相比，ChronoProp 在图像分类中达到相近准确率，在所测试的最细时间步下训练时间约少 3 倍、内存约少 20 倍，脉冲最多少 10 倍。在口语词基准上，ChronoProp 在细时间步下的循环网络中准确率远更高，并且借助简单、硬件兼容的技术，其性能接近已发表的最佳模型。这些网络对模拟硬件缺陷和限制的容忍度也优于使用随时间反向传播训练的网络。因此，ChronoProp 使得在接近模拟硬件连续时间的仿真中进行稳定而高效的训练成为可能。

items.title_en: Where Does the Asymmetry Enter? Staging a Fairness Audit Across a Fused Multimodal Moderation Pipeline
items.title_zh: 不对称从何处进入？在融合多模态审核流水线中分阶段开展公平性审计
items.abstract_en: Almost every short-video upload now passes through a classifier that fuses video, speech, and on-screen text into one decision about whether it may be seen. It moderates every language community on the platform at once, and fairness across them is judged, if at all, from one accuracy score. That score is compatible with error falling almost entirely on one language group. An audit that goes looking reads the model's decisions, the last stage of a long pipeline and the one whose test has the fewest items. We ask where in a fused pipeline a subgroup asymmetry can be detected at all: in what the classifier may read, in what its branches encode, or in what it decides. We answer this with a post-hoc audit of a published TikTok classifier, holding all three stages to one significance standard using only its logged decisions, labels, and pre-fusion features, with source language as the subgroup axis. The asymmetry is significant at the stage deciding what the model may read, and again in what the text branch encodes. At the earlier stage, a language-blind cap admits less of a Vietnamese clip than an English one, for reasons of segmentation, not verbosity. The asymmetry is undetectable at the decision, where the smallest subgroup leaves twelve items to test. An audit reading only decisions looks where its evidence is thinnest; the same test staged upstream recovers a disparity the decision-level view returns as noise.
items.abstract_zh: 如今几乎每次短视频上传都会经过一个分类器，该分类器将视频、语音和屏幕文字融合为关于其是否可被看见的单一决策。它同时审核平台上的每个语言社区，而跨社区的公平性——如果有评判的话——仅依据一个准确率分数来评判。该分数与错误几乎完全落在一个语言群体上的情况是相容的。一项主动探查的审计读取的是模型决策，即长流水线的最后阶段，也是测试项目最少的阶段。我们追问在融合流水线中究竟何处可以检测到子组不对称：在分类器可以读取的内容中，在其各分支所编码的内容中，还是在其所决定的内容中。我们通过对一个已发表的 TikTok 分类器进行事后审计来回答这一问题，仅使用其记录的决策、标签和融合前特征，将全部三个阶段置于同一显著性标准下，并以源语言作为子组轴。不对称在决定模型可以读取什么的阶段显著，在文本分支所编码的内容中也再次显著。在较早阶段，一个语言盲的上限使越南语片段比英语片段被允许的更少，原因是分割，而非冗长。在决策阶段，不对称不可检测，因为最小子组仅留下十二个项目用于检验。仅读取决策的审计看向其证据最薄弱之处；将同样的检验置于上游，可恢复出决策级视角视为噪声的差异。

items.title_en: MERLoc: Robust Robot Localization in Dynamic Environments with Pose-Based Retrieval over 3D Gaussian Splatting References
items.title_zh: MERLoc：动态环境中基于位姿检索 3D 高斯泼溅参考的鲁棒机器人定位
items.abstract_en: Robots operating in previously mapped spaces must localize accurately despite moving people and rearranged objects. Most localization pipelines match the query against a sparse set of captured reference images retrieved by appearance, which is brittle under scene change and repeating structures. We present MERLoc, which turns a single metric 3D Gaussian Splatting scan into a dense Functional Reference Memory. Reference views are sampled over the navigable space for the robot's morphology and sensors at a target density and rendered offline. Pre-encoding them for the chosen off-the-shelf localizer removes the reference encoder from inference. A pose-based retrieval strategy then selects references by spatial proximity and viewing direction rather than appearance, sidestepping visual ambiguities whenever a prior exists. Across one classical and four learned localizers in simulated and real dynamic scenes, pose-based retrieval matches or outperforms appearance retrieval in most cases, even when the latter is gated by the same prior. On real data, it lowers position RMSE by 15-60 % in nine of ten backend/split combinations, and the rendered memory outperforms real-image caches posed by Structure-from-Motion. The system runs onboard a Jetson Orin NX at 5 Hz, enabling a navigation policy to successfully traverse a hallway with people roaming and rearranging objects.
items.abstract_zh: 在先前已建图空间中运行的机器人，尽管存在走动的人和被重新摆放的物体，也必须准确进行定位。大多数定位流水线将查询与通过外观检索得到的一组稀疏捕获参考图像进行匹配，这在场景变化和重复结构下很脆弱。我们提出 MERLoc，它将单次度量 3D 高斯泼溅扫描转换为密集的功能参考记忆。参考视图针对机器人的形态和传感器，以目标密度在可导航空间上采样并离线渲染。为所选现成定位器预先编码这些视图，可在推理中移除参考编码器。随后，基于位姿的检索策略按空间邻近性和观察方向而非外观选择参考，从而在存在先验时规避视觉歧义。在仿真和真实动态场景中，跨一个经典定位器和四个学习型定位器，基于位姿的检索在大多数情况下匹配或优于外观检索，即使后者受相同先验门控。在真实数据上，它在十个后端/划分组合中的九个将位置 RMSE 降低 15–60%，并且渲染记忆优于由 Structure-from-Motion 估计位姿的真实图像缓存。该系统在 Jetson Orin NX 上以 5 Hz 板载运行，使导航策略能够成功穿过有人走动并重新摆放物体的走廊。

items.title_en: Evidence-Aligned Benchmarking and Learning for Medical Video Language Models
items.title_zh: 面向医学视频语言模型的证据对齐基准测试与学习
items.abstract_en: A medical video language model should answer from the visual evidence its question asks about. We find three places where this breaks down and address each with an approach we call MedEvidU. First, benchmarks reward answers that ignore the video: on one dataset, the position of a clip within its recording predicts the surgical step in 37% of questions, and a constant answer beats every trained model on a standard safety-assessment metric. We build MedVidBench-v2, 34 tasks from 18 surgical and clinical video datasets, in which prompts and metrics are audited with answers given without video, and which tests unseen hospitals and windows cut blindly from whole recordings. Second, common video encoders merge consecutive frames into shared tokens, so a question about one frame is answered from a blend of two. Query-slot inputs give each queried frame its own tokens at almost no extra cost. Third, a fine-tuned model has memorized its training questions, which leaves little to learn from. Label-matched question resampling (LQR) adds unseen questions about the same recordings while keeping the answer distribution fixed, in a final supervised epoch and in reinforcement learning. Together, these raise the grounding IoU of a 4B model from 30.4 to 44.4, above a supervised 27B model, and instrument grounding at an unseen hospital from 33.9 to 72.5. On blindly cut windows, event-presence accuracy improves by 5.5 points and localization F1 by 8.1 points. Project page: https://gaozhongpai.github.io/MedEvidU/
items.abstract_zh: 医学视频语言模型应当根据其问题所针对的视觉证据来回答。我们发现这一要求在三处失效，并用一种称为 MedEvidU 的方法逐一处理。第一，基准会奖励忽略视频的答案：在某个数据集上，片段在其录像中的位置可在 37% 的问题中预测手术步骤；在标准安全性评估指标上，一个恒定答案胜过所有训练过的模型。我们构建了 MedVidBench-v2，包含来自 18 个手术和临床视频数据集的 34 个任务，其中提示和指标通过在不提供视频时给出的答案进行审计，并测试未见过医院以及从完整录像中盲切出的窗口。第二，常见视频编码器将连续帧合并为共享 token，因此关于某一帧的问题会由两帧的混合来回答。查询槽输入以几乎无额外成本为每个被查询帧提供自己的 token。第三，微调模型已记住其训练问题，因而可供学习的内容很少。标签匹配的问题重采样（LQR）在最后一个监督轮次和强化学习中，加入关于相同录像的未见过问题，同时保持答案分布固定。这些方法共同将 4B 模型的 grounding IoU 从 30.4 提升到 44.4，高于一个监督式 27B 模型，并将未见过医院中的器械 grounding 从 33.9 提升到 72.5。在盲切窗口上，事件存在准确率提升 5.5 个百分点，定位 F1 提升 8.1 个百分点。项目页面：https://gaozhongpai.github.io/MedEvidU/

items.title_en: GABIF: An Adaptive Guided Graph Denoising Framework for Antibody Conditional Inverse Folding
items.title_zh: GABIF：用于抗体条件逆折叠的自适应引导图去噪框架
items.abstract_en: Antibodies play a central role in the human immune system, and their design is critical for vaccine development, therapeutic intervention, and improving human longevity. However, the vast combinatorial search space of antibodies poses a fundamental challenge for de novo discovery. Recent advances in deep learning, particularly denoising diffusion models, have demonstrated strong potential in protein inverse folding. Nevertheless, existing approaches are largely constrained to learning from natural antibody repertoires, thereby generating sequences that closely resemble natural antibodies. Such similarity, however, does not necessarily translate into improved functional performance in downstream applications. In this work, we develop a novel generative protein design model that enables the generation and optimization of antibody sequences tailored to specific downstream tasks and target metrics. Besides training on given an antibody dataset, we guide the generative model by an antibody-antigen binding affinity predictor for conditional discrete diffusion. The model is pre-trained on a given antibody dataset. Meanwhile, an antibody-antigen binding affinity predictor is incorporated as a conditional signal in a discrete diffusion framework, where a regressor serves as the conditional probability to guide the learning of the amino acid probability distribution of sequences under the objective of affinity optimization. In silico experiments demonstrate that our antibody design model achieves performance comparable to state-of-the-art approaches, while the proposed regressor effectively improves binding affinity, as validated by an independent external predictor. Furthermore, our results highlight that the combination of finetuning and supervised guidance provides a powerful paradigm for adapting pretrained models to downstream tasks.
items.abstract_zh: 抗体在人类免疫系统中发挥核心作用，其设计对疫苗开发、治疗干预和改善人类长寿至关重要。然而，抗体巨大的组合搜索空间对从头发现构成了根本性挑战。深度学习的最新进展，尤其是去噪扩散模型，已在蛋白质逆折叠中展现出强大潜力。尽管如此，现有方法在很大程度上局限于从天然抗体库中学习，从而生成与天然抗体高度相似的序列。然而，这种相似性并不必然转化为下游应用中功能表现的提升。在本工作中，我们开发了一种新型生成式蛋白质设计模型，能够生成并优化针对特定下游任务和目标指标定制的抗体序列。除了在给定抗体数据集上训练之外，我们通过抗体-抗原结合亲和力预测器引导生成模型，以进行条件离散扩散。模型在给定抗体数据集上预训练。同时，将抗体-抗原结合亲和力预测器作为条件信号纳入离散扩散框架，其中回归器充当条件概率，以在亲和力优化目标下指导序列氨基酸概率分布的学习。计算机模拟实验表明，我们的抗体设计模型达到与最先进方法相当的性能，而所提出的回归器有效提高了结合亲和力，并经由独立外部预测器验证。此外，我们的结果强调，微调与监督引导的结合为将预训练模型适配到下游任务提供了强大范式。

items.title_en: Tweezing microparticles by tightly focused optical skyrmionic fields
items.title_zh: 用紧聚焦光学斯格明子场镊取微粒
items.abstract_en: The concept of skyrmions, once translated to the optical domain, provides a topological framework to investigate structured light-matter interactions. However, their practical use for the manipulation of material systems remains barely explored. Here, we experimentally demonstrate trapping and tunable orbital motion of dielectric microparticles in tightly focused skyrmionic polarization textures prepared using a compact spin-orbit optical element. We explore the tweezing capabilities at fixed topology either by varying the relative weights of the orthogonally polarized components or by switching between skyrmion and bimeron polarization textures. Vectorial focusing and optical-force calculations qualitatively reproduce the experimental observations. These results motivate extending skyrmionic light to the manipulation of micro-objects, including birefringent and chiral samples.
items.abstract_zh: 斯格明子的概念一旦被转换到光学领域，就为研究结构光-物质相互作用提供了一个拓扑框架。然而，其在操控材料体系方面的实际应用仍鲜有探索。在此，我们实验演示了在使用紧凑型自旋-轨道光学元件制备的紧聚焦斯格明子偏振织构中，介电微粒的捕获和可调轨道运动。我们通过改变正交偏振分量的相对权重，或在斯格明子与双半子（bimeron）偏振织构之间切换，探索固定拓扑下的光镊能力。矢量聚焦和光力计算定性地再现了实验观察。这些结果推动将斯格明子光拓展到微物体操控，包括双折射和手性样品。

items.title_en: Interpretable identification of constitutive parameter field for three-dimensional heterogeneous and graded hyperelastic materials from full-field displacements
items.title_zh: 基于全场位移的三维非均质与梯度超弹性材料本构参数场的可解释识别
items.abstract_en: The inverse problem of identifying spatially varying material properties of heterogeneous solids using experimentally available displacement fields and boundary reaction forces alone remains challenging. Being able to characterize heterogeneous and graded solids would be advantageous in the design and manufacturing of functionally graded materials and composites. Additionally, an efficient technique for identifying heterogeneous material properties from in vivo measurements would be useful in biomedical contexts to characterize heterogeneous biological tissues. Although several techniques developed over the past two decades have addressed inverse identification for homogeneous materials, including linear elastic, hyperelastic, viscoelastic, and elastoplastic solids, comparatively fewer studies have considered heterogeneous and graded materials. Furthermore, several recent approaches to characterizing heterogeneous and graded materials employ parameter-heavy, deep learning-based frameworks trained to enforce force equilibrium at specified collocation points within the material. In this work, we propose an interpretable and time-efficient framework that predicts the three-dimensional relative spatial variation of a constitutive parameter field for multiple parameters of a heterogeneous hyperelastic material, using only displacement-field data. In this work, we validate our framework on 3D synthetic and 2D experimental benchmarks involving heterogeneous, graded, and anisotropic hyperelastic materials. By leveraging the linear nature of the inverse problem for hyperelastic materials and directly optimizing for the constitutive parameters at the finite-element level, we achieve acceptable prediction accuracy with significantly lower computational time compared to recently reported deep-learning-based frameworks.
items.abstract_zh: 仅利用实验可获得的位移场和边界反力来识别非均质固体的空间变化材料属性，这一反问题仍然具有挑战性。能够表征非均质和梯度固体，将有利于功能梯度材料和复合材料的设计与制造。此外，一种从体内测量中识别非均质材料属性的高效技术，将在生物医学场景中用于表征非均质生物组织。尽管过去二十年开发的若干技术已解决均质材料的逆识别问题，包括线弹性、超弹性、黏弹性和弹塑性固体，但考虑非均质和梯度材料的研究相对较少。此外，近期若干表征非均质和梯度材料的方法采用参数繁重的基于深度学习的框架，这些框架经训练以在材料内指定配点处强制力平衡。在本工作中，我们提出一个可解释且时间高效的框架，仅使用位移场数据，预测非均质超弹性材料多个参数的本构参数场的三维相对空间变化。在本工作中，我们在涉及非均质、梯度和各向异性超弹性材料的三维合成和二维实验基准上验证了我们的框架。通过利用超弹性材料反问题的线性性质，并在有限元层面直接优化本构参数，与近期报道的基于深度学习的框架相比，我们以显著更低的计算时间达到可接受的预测精度。

items.title_en: Mitigating Hallucinations in Medical Question Answering on ESC Cardiology Guidelines: Evaluation and Retrieval Optimization
items.title_zh: 缓解基于ESC心脏病学指南的医学问答中的幻觉：评估与检索优化
items.abstract_en: Background: Large language models produce hallucinations in medical question answering (QA). Verify-and-revise pipelines that check atomic claims against retrieved guideline evidence are a standard mitigation, but evaluations almost universally treat the verifier's output as ground truth, an assumption rarely tested. Objective: To measure, claim by claim against human judgement, how such a pipeline fails in a guideline-grounded clinical setting. Methods: We built a dataset of 160 questions (100 patient vignettes from 89 de-identified cases, 60 fact-based) over four recent ESC cardiology guidelines, all approved by a practising internist, and a retrieval corpus of 627 hand-verified guideline records at two chunk granularities. A five-stage pipeline was run under four retrieval configurations and three independent runs (1920 arm-runs); all 606 first-pass refuted claims were manually audited, an independent judge re-judged 906 decisions, and the expert blindly reviewed 100 accepted claims. Results: Only 44.7-50.6% of flagged claims were true hallucinations. Correction loops converged in 85.2-95.1% of cases, yet 35% of genuine final errors were introduced by correction. Single-run true-hallucination recall was 35.6-41.2%, the three-run union 71-80%; verifier agreement was moderate (kappa = 0.505). The blind probe estimated the accepted-claim miss rate at 3.2% (95% CI 0.7-6.7%). Final genuine-error rate: 1.7% of answers. Conclusion: Claim-level verification reduces hallucinated content by an order of magnitude, but verifier reliability, not generation, is the limiting factor and must be measured, not assumed.
items.abstract_zh: 背景：大语言模型在医学问答（QA）中会产生幻觉。通过对照检索到的指南证据检查原子声明，验证并修订流程是一种标准缓解措施，但评估几乎普遍将验证器的输出视为真值，这一假设很少被检验。目的：以人类判断为对照，逐条声明测量此类流程在基于指南的临床环境中如何失效。方法：我们构建了一个包含 160 个问题的数据集（100 个来自 89 个去标识化病例的患者情境题，60 个基于事实题），覆盖四部近期 ESC 心脏病学指南，全部由一名执业内科医生审核批准；并构建了包含 627 条经人工核验指南记录的检索语料库，采用两种分块粒度。一个五阶段流程在四种检索配置和三次独立运行下运行（1920 次分支运行）；所有 606 条首轮被驳斥的声明均经人工审计，一名独立评判者重新评判了 906 项决策，专家盲审了 100 条被接受的声明。结果：仅 44.7-50.6% 被标记的声明是真实幻觉。校正循环在 85.2-95.1% 的案例中收敛，但 35% 的真实最终错误是由校正引入的。单次运行的真实幻觉召回率为 35.6-41.2%，三次运行的并集为 71-80%；验证器一致性为中等（kappa = 0.505）。盲测探查估计被接受声明的漏检率为 3.2%（95% CI 0.7-6.7%）。最终真实错误率：占答案的 1.7%。结论：声明级验证将幻觉内容减少一个数量级，但限制因素不是生成，而是验证器可靠性，且必须测量而非假设。

items.title_en: SkySearcher: High-Altitude Onboard VLM Reasoning for Aerial Semantic Search
items.title_zh: SkySearcher：用于空中语义搜索的高空机载VLM推理
items.abstract_en: Recent advances in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have improved semantic and visual reasoning, enabling UAVs to search for open-vocabulary queries in unstructured environments at high altitude. However, existing systems mainly follow low-altitude strategies, focusing on close-range iterative exploration, requiring storage-intensive dense 3D metric-semantic reconstructions or relying on large cloud-serviced VLMs assuming constant internet access. We propose SkySearcher, an aerial semantic search navigation method designed for large outdoor scenes. SkySearcher integrates onboard VLM reasoning with a lightweight probabilistic representation that guides an information-driven exploration. The VLM extracts semantic information at high altitude about the target or cues informing about its location. This information is projected to the ground using the camera frustum instead of limited-depth sensors, actively exploiting the expansive field of view offered by elevated sensing. The information regarding the presence or absence of semantic cues is then integrated into a probabilistic map by modeling the spatial belief of the query, maintaining a task-driven memory for the mission and guiding the exploration towards semantically promising regions. Extensive simulations for Aerial Object Goal Navigation on public benchmarks demonstrate that SkySearcher significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in success rate, flight time, and navigation precision, while a deployment of SkySercher running fully onboard a drone demonstrates the applicability of our approach.
items.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言模型（VLM）的最新进展改善了语义和视觉推理，使无人机能够在高空非结构化环境中搜索开放词汇查询。然而，现有系统主要遵循低空策略，侧重于近距离迭代探索，需要存储密集的稠密三维度量-语义重建，或依赖假设持续联网的大型云服务 VLM。我们提出 SkySearcher，一种面向大型户外场景的空中语义搜索导航方法。SkySearcher 将机载 VLM 推理与轻量级概率表示相结合，以引导信息驱动的探索。VLM 在高空提取关于目标或指示其位置的线索的语义信息。该信息使用相机视锥而非有限深度传感器投影到地面，主动利用高空传感所提供的广阔视野。然后，通过建模查询的空间信念，将关于语义线索存在与否的信息整合到概率地图中，为任务维护任务驱动的记忆，并引导探索朝向语义上有希望的区域。在公开基准上针对空中物体目标导航的大量仿真表明，SkySearcher 在成功率、飞行时间和导航精度上显著优于最先进基线，而将 SkySearcher 完全部署在无人机上运行展示了我们方法的适用性。

items.title_en: Who Is Ego? Scaling Cross-View Camera Wearer Identification and Segmentation beyond Humans
items.title_zh: 谁是Ego？将跨视角相机佩戴者识别与分割扩展到人类之外
items.abstract_en: A first-person (ego) image reveals what a camera sees, but not who or what carries it. Given a synchronized third-person (exo) image, camera wearer identification asks who is ego: which candidate carries the ego camera? We extend this task beyond humans to robots, vehicles, animals, and drones, and broaden its spatial scope (where is ego) from selecting a provided candidate mask to wearer segmentation with absence prediction and mutual camera localization across ego-exo views. We introduce FindEgo-1M, comprising 1.16M real and simulated ego-exo pairs across 12 wearer types, 17 domains, and 111 test settings. Our approach exploits a geometric relation: the ego camera's projection into the exo image, i.e., the epipole, lies on or near its wearer. We introduce EgoRay-ZS, the first method to turn a frozen feed-forward 3D reconstruction model, VGGT-$Ω$, into a training-free solution for wearer identification and segmentation. Its geometric readout ranks candidate masks or segmentation proposals by angular offset and distance to the ego camera, while the relative pose provides mutual camera directions. We then develop the full EgoRay model through pose-supervised training on FindEgo-1M and label-free test-time adaptation constrained by candidate masks. Without task-specific training, EgoRay-ZS achieves 78.0% identification accuracy on TF2023's original labels, versus 52.9% reported for the dataset-trained PEN. On FindEgo-1M, EgoRay achieves state-of-the-art chance-corrected accuracy of 87.1 and 77.7 on seen and unseen settings. On matched queries, EgoRay also outperforms GPT-6 Astra by 31.6 and 21.3 points on seen and unseen settings, respectively, while running $18\times$ faster. Data, code, and models will be released.
items.abstract_zh: 第一人称（ego）图像揭示了相机看到了什么，却没有揭示是谁或什么在携带它。给定同步的第三人称（exo）图像，相机佩戴者识别要回答谁是ego：哪个候选对象携带ego相机？我们将该任务从人类扩展到机器人、车辆、动物和无人机，并将其空间范围（ego在哪里）从选择给定的候选掩码扩展到带缺席预测的佩戴者分割以及跨ego-exo视角的相互相机定位。我们提出FindEgo-1M，包含116万对真实与仿真的ego-exo图像对，覆盖12种佩戴者类型、17个领域和111个测试设置。我们的方法利用一种几何关系：ego相机在exo图像中的投影，即对极点，位于其佩戴者上或附近。我们提出EgoRay-ZS，这是首个将冻结的前馈3D重建模型VGGT-Ω转化为无需训练的佩戴者识别与分割方案的方法。其几何读出按候选掩码或分割提议到ego相机的角度偏移和距离进行排序，而相对位姿提供相互相机方向。随后，我们通过在FindEgo-1M上进行位姿监督训练，并在候选掩码约束下进行无标签测试时自适应，开发出完整的EgoRay模型。在没有任务特定训练的情况下，EgoRay-ZS在TF2023原始标签上达到78.0%的识别准确率，而据报道，经数据集训练的PEN为52.9%。在FindEgo-1M上，EgoRay在已见和未见设置上分别达到87.1和77.7的最先进机会校正准确率。在匹配查询上，EgoRay在已见和未见设置上分别比GPT-6 Astra高出31.6和21.3个百分点，同时运行速度快18倍。数据、代码和模型将发布。

items.title_en: The immunogenic 33-mer gliadin peptide attenuates flagellin-induced TLR5/NF-kB signaling
items.title_zh: 免疫原性33-mer麦醇溶蛋白肽减弱鞭毛蛋白诱导的TLR5/NF-kB信号传导
items.abstract_en: Wheat gluten is the main trigger of gluten-related disorders such as celiac disease, in which the proteolysis-resistant, 33-mer peptide is a key immunodominant factor. It has been reported that the 33-mer forms oligomers and thin-plate superstructures that accumulate in the Caco-2 intestinal epithelial cell line, although their biological effects remain only partially understood. Here, we screened the effects of these nanostructures on Toll-like receptors (TLRs) in Caco-2 cells to investigate their effect on the early innate immune response. Our findings showed a specific upregulation of TLR5 mRNA in response to the 33-mer gliadin system, although no inflammatory response was detected based on CXCL1 and CXCL8 levels. Moreover, immunofluorescence analysis revealed partial colocalization of 33-mer with TLR5. Finally, we found that 33-mer attenuates flagellin-induced TLR5/NF-kB signaling in a concentration-dependent manner in reporter cells, similar to a blocking anti-hTLR5-IgA2 antibody. Molecular docking suggested that the 33-mer peptide could occupy the concave region of TLR5 and 54% of the TLR5-LR5 dimerization interface. Altogether, our findings reveal a previously unrecognized capacity of the 33-mer to modulate flagellin/TLR5/NF-kB signaling pathway in model systems. We hypothesize that 33-mer supramolecular nanostructures may act as local reservoirs, increasing local 33-mer concentration and potentially facilitating its interaction with TLR5, consistent with a plausible binding mode suggested by molecular docking studies. Because TLR5 contributes not only to inflammation but also to intestinal homeostasis, these findings warrant further investigation into how 33-mer supramolecular organization modulates TLR5 signaling as part of the early innate immune response to gluten peptides.
items.abstract_zh: 小麦麸质是乳糜泻等麸质相关疾病的主要诱因，其中抗蛋白水解的33-mer肽是关键免疫显性因子。已有报道称，33-mer会形成寡聚体和薄板超结构，并在Caco-2肠道上皮细胞系中积累，但其生物学效应仍仅被部分了解。在此，我们筛选了这些纳米结构对Caco-2细胞中Toll样受体（TLR）的影响，以研究其对早期先天免疫应答的作用。我们的发现显示，响应33-mer麦醇溶蛋白系统时TLR5 mRNA出现特异性上调，但基于CXCL1和CXCL8水平未检测到炎症反应。此外，免疫荧光分析显示33-mer与TLR5存在部分共定位。最后，我们发现33-mer在报告细胞中以浓度依赖方式减弱鞭毛蛋白诱导的TLR5/NF-kB信号传导，类似于阻断性抗hTLR5-IgA2抗体。分子对接提示，33-mer肽可占据TLR5的凹面区域以及TLR5-LR5二聚化界面的54%。总之，我们的发现揭示了33-mer在模型系统中调节鞭毛蛋白/TLR5/NF-kB信号通路的一种此前未被认识的能力。我们假设33-mer超分子纳米结构可能作为局部储库，提高局部33-mer浓度，并可能促进其与TLR5的相互作用，这与分子对接研究提示的合理结合模式一致。由于TLR5不仅参与炎症，也参与肠道稳态，这些发现值得进一步研究33-mer超分子组织如何作为对麸质肽早期先天免疫应答的一部分调节TLR5信号传导。

items.title_en: QuOptLab: Advancing Quantum Optics Experiments with an AI Agent
items.title_zh: QuOptLab：利用AI智能体推进量子光学实验
items.abstract_en: Recent advances in AI-assisted theoretical research suggest that AI agents can contribute to research-level problems. Whether they can also advance experimental research by conducting experiments, analyzing the results, and proposing better experimental designs remains an open question. To address this question, we build a simulated quantum optics laboratory and integrate it with an AI agent in QuOptLab. The laboratory includes optical instruments, a robotic arm, and cameras, enabling the agent to carry out and iteratively refine experiments. We consider two complementary tasks: thin-film thickness measurement in free-space optics and edge-coupler design in integrated photonics. In the thin-film thickness measurement task, the agent repeatedly analyzes measurement results and revises its measurement method, including calibration and data analysis, reducing thickness-estimation error from 7.13 to 0.066~nm$^2$ over six epochs in a classical-interference run. For edge-coupler design, the agent iteratively proposes structural modifications, evaluates the resulting coupling performance, and uses the feedback to guide subsequent revisions, increasing simulated coupling efficiency from 85.81% to 91.98%.
items.abstract_zh: 近期AI辅助理论研究的进展表明，AI智能体能够对研究级问题作出贡献。它们是否也能通过开展实验、分析结果并提出更好的实验设计来推进实验研究，仍是一个开放问题。为回答该问题，我们构建了一个仿真量子光学实验室，并在QuOptLab中将其与AI智能体集成。该实验室包括光学仪器、机械臂和相机，使智能体能够执行实验并迭代改进实验。我们考虑两个互补任务：自由空间光学中的薄膜厚度测量和集成光子学中的边缘耦合器设计。在薄膜厚度测量任务中，智能体反复分析测量结果并修改其测量方法（包括校准和数据分析），在经典干涉运行中经过六个轮次将厚度估计误差从7.13降至0.066 nm^2。对于边缘耦合器设计，智能体迭代提出结构修改、评估所得耦合性能，并利用反馈指导后续修改，将仿真耦合效率从85.81%提高到91.98%。

items.title_en: Decentralized Clustered Federated Learning for Cellular Traffic Forecasting over LEO Constellations
items.title_zh: 面向LEO星座蜂窝流量预测的去中心化聚类联邦学习
items.abstract_en: Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite constellations are positioned to act as orbital edge-compute nodes in emerging 6G non-terrestrial networks, supporting forecasting and control tasks for ground cellular infrastructure. However, training such models is challenged by heterogeneous ground-cell traffic patterns, intermittent links to ground stations, and the satellites' own orbital motion, which continuously shifts the data each satellite observes. In this work, we extend Decentralized Federated Clustering (DFCA) to the LEO setting and apply it to cellular internet-traffic forecasting on the Telecom Italia Milan+Trentino dataset. Satellites cooperate exclusively through $k$-nearest inter-satellite gossip with no ground-side aggregator, while zero-shot head selection lets each satellite specialize to the latent traffic regime of the ground cell currently beneath it. Averaged over $K{=}20$ post-training orbital snapshots, our extension reduces forecasting Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE) by $15.3\%$ over a decentralized FedAvg baseline of equivalent capacity, with cluster recovery accuracy of $85.3\%$. The results indicate that clustered specialization yields measurable gains under the structural heterogeneity inherent to realistic cellular-over-LEO scenarios.
items.abstract_zh: 低地球轨道（LEO）卫星星座正准备在新兴6G非地面网络中充当轨道边缘计算节点，支持地面蜂窝基础设施的预测与控制任务。然而，训练此类模型面临挑战：异构的地面小区流量模式、与地面站之间的间歇性链路，以及卫星自身轨道运动，后者不断改变每颗卫星所观测到的数据。在本工作中，我们将去中心化联邦聚类（DFCA）扩展到LEO场景，并将其应用于Telecom Italia Milan+Trentino数据集上的蜂窝互联网流量预测。卫星仅通过k近邻星间gossip进行协作，没有地面侧聚合器；同时，零样本头部选择使每颗卫星专门适应当前位于其下方的那个地面小区的潜在流量状态。在K=20个训练后轨道快照上平均，我们的扩展将预测均方根误差（RMSE）相对于同等容量的去中心化FedAvg基线降低15.3%，聚类恢复准确率为85.3%。结果表明，在真实蜂窝-over-LEO场景所固有的结构异质性下，聚类专门化带来了可测量的增益。

items.title_en: Learning from Unreliable Operator References: Claim-Level Rewards for Customer Support Agents
items.title_zh: 从不可靠的人工坐席参考中学习：面向客户支持智能体的声明级奖励
items.abstract_en: Even a correct operator reply can be an unreliable training target for a customer-support agent. About a quarter of the factual claims in these replies lacked full support in the agent's knowledge base and tool records. We treat operator replies as claims to verify rather than answers to imitate. Unverified claims guide revisions to the knowledge base and tools. Verified claims serve as coverage targets in a claim-level GRPO reward that scores factual precision against the evidence the agent retrieved for its answer. On an offline benchmark, 8.6% of the GRPO agent's text answers were flagged for hallucinations, compared with 13.6% for the supervised fine-tuning baseline. In a randomized A/B test against the existing procedural bot, the deployed system increased the share of conversations closed without a human operator from 63.3% to 80.8%.
items.abstract_zh: 即使是正确的人工坐席回复，也可能成为客户支持智能体不可靠的训练目标。这些回复中约四分之一的事实性声明在智能体的知识库和工具记录中缺乏充分支持。我们将人工坐席回复视为需要核验的声明，而不是要模仿的答案。未核验的声明指导对知识库和工具的修订。已核验的声明作为声明级GRPO奖励中的覆盖目标，该奖励根据智能体为其答案检索到的证据来评分事实精确率。在离线基准上，GRPO智能体有8.6%的文本答案被标记为幻觉，而监督微调基线为13.6%。在与现有流程机器人进行的随机A/B测试中，已部署系统将在无人工坐席情况下结束的对话占比从63.3%提高到80.8%。

items.title_en: xFORM: Accelerating Fixed-Lag LiDAR Odometry with Exact Factor Compression
items.title_zh: xFORM：利用精确因子压缩加速固定滞后LiDAR里程计
items.abstract_en: Light Detection and Ranging (LiDAR) sensors are increasingly popular for state estimation because of their precision, long range, and high measurement rate. Unfortunately, LiDAR Odometry (LO) systems incur substantial computational cost when processing large point clouds, particularly those that jointly refine a window of scan poses. While our prior LO work FORM is real-time, the costs of feature extraction, correspondence search, and the evaluation and linearization of residuals during pose optimization can introduce significant latency. This latency makes downstream tasks such as control and path planning difficult. To overcome this, we present xFORM, which accelerates the three stages of FORM. xFORM uses factor compression to reduce an optimization problem involving hundreds of thousands of feature matches to 34 scalar residuals per scan pair, while preserving the original objective and Gauss-Newton system in exact arithmetic. We integrate this optimizer into two variants: xFORM-CPU, which additionally parallelizes feature extraction on the CPU, and xFORM-GPU, which accelerates feature processing, correspondence search, and factor compression on the GPU. Across fifteen complete sequences from three datasets, xFORM-CPU and xFORM-GPU achieve overall speedups of 1.1-1.4$\times$ and 2.0-4.0$\times$ over FORM, respectively, with no numerically significant differences to the original implementation.
items.abstract_zh: 光探测与测距（LiDAR）传感器由于其精度、长距离和高测量速率，在状态估计中越来越受欢迎。不幸的是，LiDAR里程计（LO）系统在处理大型点云时会产生大量计算成本，尤其是那些联合优化一个扫描位姿窗口的系统。尽管我们此前的LO工作FORM是实时的，但特征提取、对应关系搜索以及位姿优化期间残差的评估与线性化的成本可能引入显著延迟。这种延迟使控制和路径规划等下游任务变得困难。为克服这一点，我们提出xFORM，它加速FORM的三个阶段。xFORM使用因子压缩，将涉及数十万特征匹配的优化问题减少为每对扫描34个标量残差，同时在精确算术中保留原始目标和高斯-牛顿系统。我们将该优化器集成到两个变体中：xFORM-CPU额外在CPU上并行化特征提取，xFORM-GPU在GPU上加速特征处理、对应关系搜索和因子压缩。在来自三个数据集的十五条完整序列上，xFORM-CPU和xFORM-GPU相对于FORM分别实现1.1-1.4倍和2.0-4.0倍的整体加速，且与原始实现没有数值上显著的差异。

items.title_en: GeoCAM: Self-Supervised Sonar-Optical Representation Learning via Geographic Overlap Supervision
items.title_zh: GeoCAM：通过地理重叠监督的自监督声呐-光学表示学习
items.abstract_en: Cross-modal self-supervised learning for paired side-scan sonar and underwater optical imagery is a promising direction for benthic habitat understanding, but it remains underexplored because existing methods do not fully exploit the one-to-many correspondences and geographic metadata available in real opti-acoustic surveys. This limits the ability to learn representations that are both semantically meaningful and geometrically consistent from abundant unlabeled marine data. To address this problem, we present GeoCAM, a geography-guided framework that learns a shared embedding space for sonar tiles and their associated optical views without semantic annotations. GeoCAM achieves its goal by combining three components: (i) a Set Attention Aggregator that adaptively summarizes multiple optical observations into a single tile-level representation; (ii) a geometry-weighted InfoNCE objective that converts GPS-derived footprint overlap into soft positive supervision; and (iii) an optional cross-modal masked reconstruction branch that encourages physically grounded cross-modal alignment. Experiments on the BenthiCat SSS-CAM dataset show that GeoCAM can be effectively exploited to learn which sonar and camera samples describe the same seabed patch, improving cross-modal retrieval and alignment over strong contrastive baselines. Code is available at https://github.com/FadiZidiDz/GeoCAM.
items.abstract_zh: 用于配对侧扫声呐与水下光学影像的跨模态自监督学习是底栖生境理解的一个有前景方向，但由于现有方法未充分利用真实光声调查中可用的一对多对应关系和地理元数据，该方向仍未得到充分探索。这限制了从大量无标签海洋数据中学习兼具语义意义和几何一致性的表示的能力。为解决该问题，我们提出 GeoCAM，一个地理引导框架，可在无语义标注情况下为声呐瓦片及其关联光学视图学习共享嵌入空间。GeoCAM 通过组合三个组件实现其目标：(i) 一个 Set Attention Aggregator，自适应地将多个光学观测汇总为单个瓦片级表示；(ii) 一个几何加权 InfoNCE 目标，将 GPS 推导的足迹重叠转换为软正监督；(iii) 一个可选的跨模态掩码重建分支，鼓励具有物理依据的跨模态对齐。在 BenthiCat SSS-CAM 数据集上的实验表明，GeoCAM 可被有效用于学习哪些声呐和相机样本描述同一海底斑块，相较强对比基线改进了跨模态检索与对齐。代码见 https://github.com/FadiZidiDz/GeoCAM。

items.title_en: Intravenous BCG Elicits a Sustained Myeloid IFNG Response Signature Associated with Early TB Control
items.title_zh: 静脉注射 BCG 引发与早期结核控制相关的持续性髓系 IFNG 反应特征
items.abstract_en: Bacille Calmette-Guerin (BCG) administered intravenously (IV) to rhesus macaques can prevent pulmonary tuberculosis (TB) infection. To establish transcriptional correlates of protection, we generated longitudinal CITE-Seq data across blood and lung after IV BCG in macaques and compared it to clinically approved intradermal (ID) BCG. We define an interferon gamma (IFNG) response signature in alveolar macrophages (AMs) comprising 61 genes with diverging expression between IV and ID BCG from 4 to 16 weeks after vaccination that was also enriched in AMs early after TB challenge. The signature was recapitulated in blood monocytes (IV vs. ID) and associated with protection in an independent cohort of IV BCG-vaccinated macaques. Cell-cell communication analysis inferred increased ligand-receptor interactions in the airway after IV BCG, including those between multiple IFNG-producing T cell subsets and AMs. The sustained IFNG response signature in AMs after IV BCG provides a new correlate and potential mechanism of early TB control informing future vaccine design.
items.abstract_zh: 将卡介苗（BCG）经静脉（IV）给予恒河猴可预防肺结核（TB）感染。为建立保护的转录相关物，我们在恒河猴 IV BCG 后生成跨血液和肺的纵向 CITE-Seq 数据，并将其与临床批准的皮内（ID）BCG 进行比较。我们定义了肺泡巨噬细胞（AM）中的干扰素γ（IFNG）反应特征，该特征包含 61 个基因，在疫苗接种后 4 至 16 周时 IV 与 ID BCG 之间表达出现分化，并且在 TB 攻击后早期也富集于 AM。该特征在血液单核细胞中（IV 对 ID）得到重现，并在一个独立的 IV BCG 疫苗接种恒河猴队列中与保护相关。细胞-细胞通讯分析推断，IV BCG 后气道中配体-受体相互作用增加，包括多个产生 IFNG 的 T 细胞亚群与 AM 之间的相互作用。IV BCG 后 AM 中持续存在的 IFNG 反应特征提供了早期 TB 控制的新相关物和潜在机制，可为未来疫苗设计提供信息。

items.title_en: Voltage-Enhanced Photorefractive Hysteresis in Thin-Film Lithium Niobate Photonic-Crystal Cavities
items.title_zh: 薄膜铌酸锂光子晶体腔中电压增强的光折变迟滞
items.abstract_en: We observe voltage-enhanced photorefractive hysteresis in thin-film lithium niobate nanocavities, causing the resonance to appear at different wavelengths during increasing- and decreasing-wavelength laser scans. Their separation grows with bias magnitude and optical power, but depends weakly on scan speed over 1-200 nm/s. A quasi-static surface-trap model links voltage-biased carrier transport to asymmetric trapping, whose space-charge field shifts the resonance through the Pockels effect. The model captures this hysteresis across three cavities through switching between stable steady states. Space-charge feedback opposes further carrier separation, limiting the hysteresis gap. The model informs photorefractive mitigation and resonance control in integrated electro-optic devices.
items.abstract_zh: 我们在薄膜铌酸锂纳米腔中观察到电压增强的光折变迟滞，导致在波长增加和减少的激光扫描期间共振出现在不同波长处。它们的间隔随偏置幅度和光功率增大，但在 1–200 nm/s 范围内对扫描速度依赖较弱。一个准静态表面陷阱模型将电压偏置的载流子输运与非对称俘获联系起来，其空间电荷场通过普克尔斯效应移动共振。该模型通过稳定稳态之间的切换，在三个腔中捕捉到这种迟滞。空间电荷反馈阻碍进一步的载流子分离，从而限制迟滞间隙。该模型可为集成电光器件中的光折变抑制和共振控制提供依据。

items.title_en: RHOPE: LLM-Augmented Adaptive Experimental Design with Complex Contextual Information
items.title_zh: RHOPE：具有复杂上下文信息的 LLM 增强自适应实验设计
items.abstract_en: Experimental design allocates limited measurement effort across candidate treatments to learn their expected outcomes. Adaptive designs refine allocations as evidence accumulates, improving estimation and treatment selection. Contextual information can inform these decisions, but exploiting unstructured or high-dimensional context remains challenging. We use large language models (LLMs) to transform complex context into proxy outcomes and propose Residual Horizon Optimization for Prediction-Powered Experimentation (RHOPE), a principled Bayesian adaptive experimentation framework that combines true outcomes with LLM-generated proxy outcomes and formulates finite-batch design as a posterior Markov decision process (MDP). Our methodology uses proxy outcomes in two ways: sample augmentation improves estimation precision, while observing proxies before each allocation decision provides advance information. Synthetic experiments and semi-synthetic experiments using Genomics of Drug Sensitivity in Cancer (GDSC) data suggest that estimation precision drives most gains, with smaller advance-information gains, and highlight the importance of proxy informativeness and moment-estimation accuracy.
items.abstract_zh: 实验设计将有限的测量投入分配到候选处理上，以学习其预期结果。自适应设计随着证据积累而细化分配，从而改进估计和处理选择。上下文信息可为这些决策提供信息，但利用非结构化或高维上下文仍具挑战性。我们使用大语言模型（LLM）将复杂上下文转换为代理结果，并提出用于预测驱动实验的残差视野优化（RHOPE），这是一个有原则的贝叶斯自适应实验框架，将真实结果与 LLM 生成的代理结果相结合，并将有限批次设计形式化为后验马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）。我们的方法以两种方式使用代理结果：样本增强提高估计精度，而在每次分配决策前观察代理可提供提前信息。合成实验和使用癌症药物敏感性基因组学（GDSC）数据的半合成实验表明，估计精度驱动了大部分增益，提前信息增益较小，并强调了代理信息量和矩估计准确性的重要性。

items.title_en: PINN-Slicer: Exploiting Rotational Symmetry to Solve the Photon Orbit Equation Around a Black Hole
items.title_zh: PINN-Slicer：利用旋转对称性求解黑洞周围光子轨道方程
items.abstract_en: Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) typically struggle with long-horizon domains, often requiring the network to be retrained as the domain grows. We present PINN-Slicer, a method for second-order autonomous ordinary differential equations, $\ddot{u} = G(u, \dot{u})$, which exploits the invariance of this class of equations under translations of the independent variable. A single PINN, embedded within a solution ansatz that enforces the initial conditions explicitly, is trained on a thin slice of the independent variable using Sobol-sampled initial conditions. The PINN is then deployed recursively, slice-by-slice, across the full domain. We demonstrate PINN-Slicer on the nonlinear equation that describes photon orbits around a black hole, and reach a point-by-point root-mean-square error (RMSE) below $10^{-3}$ in $u = r_s/r$ (the inverse radial coordinate in units of the Schwarzschild radius) relative to a finite-difference reference solution. A key advantage of PINN-Slicer is that a single trained network generalizes to any orbital initial condition within the training range, without retraining. In addition, PINN-Slicer can cope with solution domains that may not be known a priori.
items.abstract_zh: 物理信息神经网络（PINN）通常难以处理长时程域，随着域增长往往需要重新训练网络。我们提出 PINN-Slicer，一种用于二阶自治常微分方程 $\ddot{u} = G(u, \dot{u})$ 的方法，它利用该类方程在自变量平移下的不变性。单个 PINN 被嵌入一个显式施加初始条件的解拟设中，并使用 Sobol 采样的初始条件在自变量的薄片上训练。随后，该 PINN 在整个域上逐片递归部署。我们在描述黑洞周围光子轨道的非线性方程上演示 PINN-Slicer，相对于有限差参考解，在 $u = r_s/r$（以史瓦西半径为单位的倒数径向坐标）中达到逐点均方根误差（RMSE）低于 $10^{-3}$。PINN-Slicer 的一个关键优势是，单个训练好的网络可泛化到训练范围内的任意轨道初始条件，而无需重新训练。此外，PINN-Slicer 能够处理可能无法先验已知的解域。

items.title_en: FailPoint-X: A Policy-Matched, Failure-Anchored Benchmark for Offline VLA Post-Training from Human Takeovers
items.title_zh: FailPoint-X：用于从人类接管进行离线 VLA 后训练的策略匹配、失败锚定基准
items.abstract_en: Human takeovers offer corrective supervision for vision-language-action (VLA) policies, but their contribution to offline post-training must be separated from that of continued optimization. We introduce FailPoint-X, a benchmark for offline VLA post-training with human takeovers. To represent uncertainty in failure onset, an annotator marks an interval for each failure, and training takeovers start at seeded frames sampled within it. From one fixed $π_{0.5}$ checkpoint, which also initializes post-training, we assemble 629 natural failures across 10 LIBERO-X task families at up to five difficulty levels. All 2,823 takeover attempts are logged; 2,400 are accepted recoveries, of which 2,320 are used for post-training. Evaluation restarts every method from the fixed midpoints of 384 held-out failure intervals. Under matched actor-update counts, we compare behavior cloning of recoveries, value-based offline learning on recoveries and failed rollouts, and continued training on existing demonstrations. Within 1,200 steps on the 240 L1-L3 held-out failures, cloning improves recovery by 29.4 percentage points (pp) over the demonstration-only control; the value-based learner does not establish a further gain (1.5 pp). In exploratory evaluation from L1-L5 nominal starts at the same horizon, cloning loses 30.0 pp of success relative to the base policy; mixing in demonstrations reduces the loss to 16.5 pp, a reduction that shrinks under a stricter, pre-specified horizon. Restorable failure states and a shared evaluator let all methods be compared from identical starts.
items.abstract_zh: 人类接管为视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略提供纠正监督，但其对离线后训练的贡献必须与持续优化的贡献区分开。我们提出 FailPoint-X，一个用于从人类接管进行离线 VLA 后训练的基准。为表示失败起始的不确定性，标注者为每次失败标记一个区间，训练用接管从该区间内采样的种子帧开始。从一个固定的 $π_{0.5}$ 检查点（该检查点也用于初始化后训练）出发，我们在 10 个 LIBERO-X 任务家族、最多五个难度级别上汇集了 629 个自然失败。记录所有 2,823 次接管尝试；其中 2,400 次为被接受的恢复，2,320 次用于后训练。评估从 384 个留出失败区间的固定中点重新启动每种方法。在匹配的 actor 更新次数下，我们比较对恢复进行行为克隆、在恢复和失败轨迹上进行基于价值的离线学习，以及在现有演示上进行持续训练。在 240 个 L1–L3 留出失败上，1,200 步内，克隆相较仅演示对照组将恢复率提高 29.4 个百分点（pp）；基于价值的学习器未建立进一步增益（1.5 pp）。在相同时间范围的 L1–L5 名义起点进行的探索性评估中，克隆相对于基础策略损失 30.0 pp 的成功率；混入演示将损失降低到 16.5 pp，而这一降低在更严格的预先指定时间范围下会缩小。可恢复的失败状态和共享评估器使所有方法能够从相同起点进行比较。

items.title_en: TAT-Det: A Dataset for Testicular Appendage Torsion Detection and Segmentation in Ultrasound Images
items.title_zh: TAT-Det：用于超声图像中睾丸附件扭转检测与分割的数据集
items.abstract_en: Background: Testicular appendage torsion (TAT) is the leading cause of acute scrotal pain in prepubertal children. Yet, its diagnosis remains challenging due to nonspecific clinical manifestations and the absence of standardized datasets for pediatric acute scrotal emergencies. Results: We present TAT-Det, an expert-annotated ultrasound dataset specifically designed for TAT. TAT-Det comprises 2,600 ultrasound images from 1,203 patients collected at the Children's Hospital, Zhejiang University School of Medicine. Each TAT-positive image is accompanied by lesion-level bounding boxes for detection and pixel-level segmentation masks for fine-grained delineation. Annotations were produced through a multi-stage workflow involving independent annotation by board-certified pediatric sonographers, consensus review, and refinement. Baseline benchmarks for object detection and semantic segmentation using representative deep learning models are further provided, with YOLO11m achieving the best detection performance and RWKV-UNet the best segmentation performance. Conclusions: TAT-Det addresses the lack of publicly available resources for pediatric emergency ultrasound and establishes a foundation for developing and evaluating artificial intelligence methods for automated TAT analysis.
items.abstract_zh: 背景：睾丸附件扭转（TAT）是青春期前儿童急性阴囊疼痛的主要原因。然而，由于其临床表现缺乏特异性，且缺乏针对儿童急性阴囊急症的标准化数据集，其诊断仍具有挑战性。结果：我们提出TAT-Det，一个专门针对TAT设计的专家标注超声数据集。TAT-Det包含来自浙江大学医学院附属儿童医院收集的1,203例患者的2,600张超声图像。每张TAT阳性图像均配有用于检测的病灶级边界框和用于细粒度勾画的像素级分割掩膜。标注通过多阶段工作流程产生，包括由获得委员会认证的儿科超声医师独立标注、共识审查和精修。进一步提供了使用代表性深度学习模型进行目标检测和语义分割的基线基准，其中YOLO11m取得最佳检测性能，RWKV-UNet取得最佳分割性能。结论：TAT-Det解决了儿科急诊超声缺乏公开可用资源的问题，并为开发和评估用于自动化TAT分析的人工智能方法奠定了基础。

items.title_en: Alternative splicing links sex to neutrophil inflammatory vulnerability
items.title_zh: 可变剪接将性别与中性粒细胞炎症易感性联系起来
items.abstract_en: Mammalian females generally live longer than males, yet the immunological drivers governing sex-biased inflammatory mortality remain unclear. Neutrophils, among conserved immune cells across species, exhibit marked sex differences in inflammatory and age-related diseases. We identified conserved male-biased CD11b expression in resting neutrophils of wild-type mice, Rag2 KO mice, and in human cohorts. Male neutrophils selectively displayed CD11b-dependent transendothelial migration. During tissue inflammation in our mouse model deficient in -Klotho (Kl) combined with Rag2 KO lymphocyte depletion (dKO), males showed higher mortality and more severe pulmonary pathology correlated with increased infiltrating neutrophils in the lung. The neutrophil accumulation directly accounted for heightened IL-1{beta} expression in males despite equivalent per-cell cytokine expression across sexes. Transcriptomic analysis of neutrophils revealed profound sex-biased alternative splicing enriched in Toll-like receptor (TLR) cascades, alongside hormone-responsive regulation of integrin {beta}2 (Itgb2) isoform usage, implicating alternative splicing in neutrophils represents male vulnerability to tissue inflammation.
items.abstract_zh: 哺乳动物雌性通常比雄性寿命更长，但调控性别偏向性炎症死亡率的免疫学驱动因素仍不清楚。中性粒细胞是跨物种保守的免疫细胞之一，在炎症性疾病和年龄相关疾病中表现出显著的性别差异。我们在野生型小鼠、Rag2敲除小鼠的静息中性粒细胞以及人类队列中，鉴定出保守的雄性/男性偏向CD11b表达。雄性中性粒细胞选择性表现出CD11b依赖的跨内皮迁移。在Klotho（Kl）缺陷联合Rag2敲除淋巴细胞耗竭（dKO）的小鼠模型的组织炎症过程中，雄性表现出更高的死亡率和更严重的肺部病理，并与肺部浸润中性粒细胞增加相关。中性粒细胞积累直接解释了雄性中IL-1β表达升高，尽管两性每细胞细胞因子表达相当。中性粒细胞的转录组分析揭示了深刻的性别偏向可变剪接，富集于Toll样受体（TLR）级联，同时伴有整合素β2（Itgb2）异构体使用的激素响应性调控，提示中性粒细胞中的可变剪接体现了雄性对组织炎症的易感性。

items.title_en: Complementary mechanisms of critical quantum metrology
items.title_zh: 临界量子计量学的互补机制
items.abstract_en: Critical metrology conventionally exploits enhanced susceptibility to a system parameter near a phase transition. Here we identify a complementary mechanism for critically enhanced estimation of intrinsic system parameters via suppressed quantum noise rather than enhanced response. We demonstrate both mechanisms in coherently radiating spin states (CRSS)-correlated states of $N$ spin-$1/2$ particles defined as asymptotic eigenstates of the collective-spin lowering operator with complex eigenvalue $r e^{-i\varphi}$. At the critical value $r=1$, CRSS exhibit a second-order transition. We show that near criticality, estimation of $r$ benefits from enhanced susceptibility despite increased noise, whereas estimation of $\varphi$ benefits from suppressed quantum noise without enhanced response. Remarkably, both yield the same estimation error $\sim N^{-2/3}$, improving over the standard quantum limit $N^{-1/2}$. For $\varphi$, this establishes quantum-enhanced metrology of phases intrinsic to the critical system, rather than phases externally encoded by interferometry. We demonstrate these results for CRSS realizations in both dissipative (superradiant) and Hamiltonian (Ising) systems relevant to cavity QED and trapped ions, where fast preparation of CRSS is shown possible thanks to gap opening. Applications to metrology of coupling rates and phases or optical lengths are discussed.
items.abstract_zh: 临界计量学传统上利用相变附近对系统参数的增强敏感性。在这里，我们确定了一种互补机制，通过抑制量子噪声而非增强响应，实现对内禀系统参数的临界增强估计。我们在N个自旋-1/2粒子的相干辐射自旋态（CRSS）关联态中展示了这两种机制，这些态定义为具有复本征值 r e^{-iφ} 的集体自旋降算符的渐近本征态。在临界值 r=1 处，CRSS表现出二阶转变。我们表明，在临界点附近，r的估计受益于增强的敏感性，尽管噪声增加；而φ的估计受益于抑制的量子噪声，而无需增强响应。值得注意的是，两者都产生相同的估计误差 ~N^{-2/3}，优于标准量子极限 N^{-1/2}。对于φ，这建立了对临界系统内禀相位的量子增强计量，而非对由干涉测量外部编码的相位的计量。我们在与腔QED和囚禁离子相关的耗散（超辐射）和哈密顿（Ising）系统中的CRSS实现上展示了这些结果，其中得益于能隙打开，CRSS的快速制备被证明是可能的。讨论了其在耦合速率以及相位或光学长度计量中的应用。

items.title_en: A gene informed benchmark for BioScoring of pathology foundation models
items.title_zh: 用于病理基础模型BioScoring的基因信息指导基准
items.abstract_en: Pathology foundation models are usually compared by their performance on downstream tasks such as classification and retrieval. While such benchmarks measure how useful a model is, they provide no insight into the biology it represents. We introduce BioScore, a benchmark that quantifies how well an image encoder captures cell identities, with spatial transcriptomics of the same tissue as the reference. A sparse autoencoder splits the encoder's patch embeddings into sparse features, which we cluster into a fixed number of groups. BioScore then measures, for each of 52 cell identities defined by marker genes, how specifically one group follows the identity's expression over the tissue. Because the autoencoder training is fully unsupervised, a match shows that the model represents the cell identity from the image alone. We score 8 pathology foundation models and 3 natural-image models. Every pathology model scores above every natural-image model (0.299--0.371 \vs 0.214--0.232), and paired tests separate three tiers among the pathology models. Unlike a supervised probe, BioScore needs no labels, builds its reference from the data and scores even from few sections, yet it ranks the encoders as a probe does. Its per-identity breakdown indicates which cell identities each encoder captures or misses.
items.abstract_zh: 病理基础模型通常通过其在分类和检索等下游任务上的性能进行比较。此类基准衡量模型有多大用处，却不能洞察其所代表的生物学。我们提出BioScore，一个以同一组织的空间转录组学为参考、量化图像编码器捕获细胞身份能力的基准。稀疏自编码器将编码器的图像块嵌入拆分为稀疏特征，我们将其聚类为固定数量的组。BioScore随后针对由标记基因定义的52种细胞身份中的每一种，测量某一组在整个组织上跟随该身份表达的特异性。由于自编码器训练完全无监督，匹配表明模型仅从图像就表示了该细胞身份。我们对8个病理基础模型和3个自然图像模型进行评分。每个病理模型的得分都高于每个自然图像模型（0.299–0.371 对 0.214–0.232），配对检验将病理模型分为三个层级。与监督探针不同，BioScore不需要标签，从数据构建参考，甚至用少量切片即可评分，但其对编码器的排名与探针一致。其按身份分解的结果表明每个编码器捕获或遗漏了哪些细胞身份。

items.title_en: What Does Skill Lift Actually Measure? A Source-Code-Level Audit and Noise-Aware Reanalysis of SkillsBench
items.title_zh: 技能提升究竟测量了什么？对SkillsBench的源代码级审计与噪声感知再分析
items.abstract_en: Agent skills are directories of instructions, reference materials, and scripts loaded on demand by coding agents. According to SkillsBench, although human-curated skills can raise the passing rate by about 16.6 percentage points (pp) on average, they have actually reduced the results for some tasks. Later research has started to gate or eliminate skills according to the above per-task gains. We have audited the above benchmark at the source-code level and analysed 7,554 public trials to form 1,421 paired "(configuration, task) cells". Source-code audit identified two controlled-verified cases of grader dependence and one operational definition gap; the average lift on these three tasks was 74.6 pp, and the overall average lift for the full set was 18.7 pp. The audit also found that four tasks contained placeholder skill directories, and a certain execution harness additionally added 48 built-in skills in most runs. No task-level reduction achieved statistical significance in the pooled reanalysis with multiple-testing correction. As there were at most three runs per condition for each cell, the observed negative differences are very susceptible to run-sampling noise, and arithmetically, 58% of the cells could not have shown a decrease. Therefore, the raw numbers of negative cells cannot show that skills cause harm. A gating strategy based on the skill-free score seems to improve by 2-3 pp in the logs; however, even after shuffling condition labels to remove any skill effect, it still achieves an increase of 4-7 pp. On the held-out runs not used for fitting and decision-making, there was no statistically significant improvement. The audit ledger and analysis scripts have been published by us.
items.abstract_zh: 智能体技能是编码智能体按需加载的指令、参考资料和脚本目录。根据SkillsBench，尽管人工整理的技能平均可将通过率提高约16.6个百分点（pp），但它们实际上降低了一些任务的结果。后续研究已开始根据上述每任务增益对技能进行门控或剔除。我们在源代码层面对上述基准进行了审计，并分析了7,554次公开试验，形成1,421个配对的“（配置，任务）单元”。源代码审计识别出两个经受控验证的评分器依赖案例和一个操作定义缺口；这三个任务的平均提升为74.6个百分点，全集总体平均提升为18.7个百分点。审计还发现四个任务包含占位符技能目录，并且某个执行框架在大多数运行中还额外添加了48个内置技能。在带多重检验校正的汇总再分析中，没有任何任务级下降达到统计学显著性。由于每个单元每种条件最多只有三次运行，观察到的负差异非常容易受到运行采样噪声的影响，而且从算术上讲，58%的单元不可能表现出下降。因此，负向单元的原始数量不能表明技能造成损害。基于无技能得分的门控策略在日志中似乎提升了2–3个百分点；然而，即使在打乱条件标签以消除任何技能效应后，它仍获得4–7个百分点的提升。在未用于拟合和决策的留出运行上，没有统计学显著改善。我们已发布审计台账和分析脚本。

items.title_en: Model Predictive Control of a Multirotor UAV with a Cable-Suspended Payload: A Comparison of Shifted and Transformer-Based Warm Starts
items.title_zh: 缆索悬挂载荷多旋翼无人机模型预测控制：移位与基于Transformer的热启动比较
items.abstract_en: This study investigates model predictive control (MPC) of a multirotor drone (unmanned aerial vehicle, UAV) carrying a cable-suspended payload, comparing conventional shifted initialization with Transformer-based warm starting of a sequential convex programming (SCP) optimizer. The controller uses a coupled mechanical model with an elastic cable and a double-pendulum representation of the suspended load. Its formulation includes move-blocked control inputs, finite-difference sensitivities, constrained quadratic subproblems, and input-feasibility projection. A Transformer trained on expert SCP solutions predicts an initial control sequence, which is subsequently refined by the same optimizer used for the conventional methods. Numerical experiments compare zero, shifted, and Transformer initialization under identical controller settings. For independently solved MPC problems, Transformer initialization reduces computation time relative to zero initialization. In sequential closed-loop simulations, however, shifting the preceding optimized control sequence provides the lowest computation time, while all three methods produce similar tracking behavior. These findings emphasize the importance of comparing learned warm starts with conventional initialization methods that reuse previous MPC solutions. The measured optimization times exceed the control sampling period; consequently, real-time implementation is not demonstrated. Keywords: Model predictive control; sequential convex programming; Transformer; warm start; cable-suspended payload; multirotor drone.
items.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨携带缆索悬挂载荷的多旋翼无人机（UAV）的模型预测控制（MPC），比较传统移位初始化与序列凸规划（SCP）优化器的基于Transformer的热启动。控制器采用包含弹性缆索和悬挂载荷双摆表示的耦合力学模型。其公式包括移动分块控制输入、有限差分灵敏度、约束二次子问题和输入可行性投影。在专家SCP解上训练的Transformer预测初始控制序列，随后由与传统方法相同的优化器进一步精化。数值实验在相同控制器设置下比较零初始化、移位初始化和Transformer初始化。对于独立求解的MPC问题，Transformer初始化相对于零初始化减少了计算时间。然而，在顺序闭环仿真中，对前一优化控制序列进行移位提供了最低的计算时间，而三种方法产生相似的跟踪行为。这些发现强调了将学习型热启动与重用先前MPC解的传统初始化方法进行比较的重要性。测得的优化时间超过控制采样周期；因此未演示实时实现。关键词：模型预测控制；序列凸规划；Transformer；热启动；缆索悬挂载荷；多旋翼无人机。

items.title_en: Improving and Expanding Video Editing Capabilities Without Videos
items.title_zh: 无需视频即可改进并扩展视频编辑能力
items.abstract_en: Image editing models can follow a wide range of instructions, but video editing models still lag behind, limited in part by the difficulty of collecting paired source and edited videos. Is it possible to transfer advanced image editing capabilities to video editors without new paired videos? We introduce Image-to-Video Transfer (I2VT), which improves pretrained video editors and expands them to new editing tasks using an image editor. It enables efficient post-training with no architectural changes and no new videos, using only individual images. Our key idea is to let the video editor role-play as an image editor: it edits an image as a one-frame video, with the image editor guiding the video editor's predictions at each denoising step. Although the video editor sees only single images during training, at test time it applies the improved and expanded capabilities to whole video clips while preserving temporal consistency. To push the boundaries of video editing, we introduce OpenVE++, an extension of OpenVE-Bench that adds four new editing tasks useful for video production, including action changes, expression changes, body movements, and scene relighting. Our experiments across three different video editors show that I2VT improves existing editing capabilities and expands them to new tasks, and our models achieve state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance on both OpenVE-Bench and OpenVE++.
items.abstract_zh: 图像编辑模型能够遵循范围广泛的指令，但视频编辑模型仍然落后，部分原因是收集成对的源视频与编辑后视频十分困难。是否可能在没有新的成对视频的情况下，把先进的图像编辑能力迁移到视频编辑器？我们提出图像到视频迁移（Image-to-Video Transfer，I2VT），它利用一个图像编辑器来改进预训练的视频编辑器，并将其扩展到新的编辑任务。该方法无需架构改动、也无需新视频，仅使用单张图像即可实现高效的后训练。我们的核心思想是让视频编辑器扮演图像编辑器的角色：它把一张图像当作单帧视频进行编辑，并在每个去噪步骤由图像编辑器指导视频编辑器的预测。尽管视频编辑器在训练时只见到单张图像，在测试时它能把改进并扩展后的能力应用于整个视频片段，同时保持时间一致性。为拓展视频编辑的边界，我们提出 OpenVE++，它是 OpenVE-Bench 的扩展，新增四项对视频制作有用的编辑任务，包括动作改变、表情改变、肢体动作和场景重打光。我们在三种不同的视频编辑器上开展的实验表明，I2VT 改进了现有的编辑能力并将其扩展到新任务，我们的模型在 OpenVE-Bench 和 OpenVE++ 上均取得最先进（SOTA）性能。

items.title_en: A tricomponent mRNA pertussis vaccine elicits superior protective immunity over licensed acellular pertussis vaccine against emerging antibiotic-resistant variants
items.title_zh: 三组分 mRNA 百日咳疫苗针对新兴抗生素耐药变异株诱导出优于已获批无细胞百日咳疫苗的保护性免疫
items.abstract_en: Pertussis remains a major global health burden and has been resurging rapidly over the past decade. The causes of pertussis re-emergence are multifactorial, including vaccine-induced pathogen evolution, antimicrobial resistance, and crucially suboptimal protective immunity elicited by the widely used acellular pertussis vaccine (aPV). In this study, we developed a tricomponent mRNA pertussis vaccine formulated with lipid nanoparticle (LNP), designated mPervax, which encodes inactive pertussis toxin subunit 1 (PTS1), truncated filamentous hemagglutinin (FHA) and pertactin (PRN). Compared to a commercialized Tetanus-diptheria-pertussis vaccine Boostrix, mPervax induced stronger and broader innate immune activation, superior antigen-specific Th1-type CD4+ T and Tfh cell responses, and robust B. pertussis-specific antibody responses with remarkably increased magnitude and functionality. In addition, mPervax conferred an efficient maternal antibody-mediated protection in offspring mice and reshaped the immune profile established by primary Boostrix immunization towards a Th1-phenotype when used as a heterologous booster. Furthermore, upon bacterial challenge, mPervax outperformed Boostrix not only against the WHO reference strain 18323, but strikingly provided effective protection against emerging antibiotic-resistant clinical isolates that are deficient in PRN and/or FHA. Collectively, these data demonstrate that the mRNA pertussis vaccine is superior to Boostrix in multiple contexts, and therefore holds promise for next-generation pertussis vaccine development.
items.abstract_zh: 百日咳仍是全球重大健康负担，并在过去十年迅速回升。百日咳重现的原因是多方面的，包括疫苗诱导的病原体演化、抗菌药物耐药性，以及关键的一点——广泛使用的无细胞百日咳疫苗（aPV）所引发的保护性免疫不够理想。在本研究中，我们开发了一种用脂质纳米颗粒（LNP）配制的三组分 mRNA 百日咳疫苗，命名为 mPervax，它编码无活性的百日咳毒素亚基 1（PTS1）、截短型丝状血凝素（FHA）和百日咳黏附素（PRN）。与已商业化的破伤风-白喉-百日咳疫苗 Boostrix 相比，mPervax 诱导更强、更广的先天免疫激活，更优的抗原特异性 Th1 型 CD4+ T 细胞和 Tfh 细胞应答，以及强劲的针对百日咳鲍特菌的抗体应答，其幅度和功能性均显著提高。此外，mPervax 在子代小鼠中提供了有效的母体抗体介导的保护；当作为异源加强针使用时，它把 Boostrix 初免疫所建立的免疫特征重塑为 Th1 表型。进一步地，在细菌攻击后，mPervax 不仅对 WHO 参考菌株 18323 优于 Boostrix，而且令人瞩目的是，对 PRN 和/或 FHA 缺陷的新兴抗生素耐药临床分离株也提供了有效保护。总体而言，这些数据表明 mRNA 百日咳疫苗在多种情境下优于 Boostrix，因而有望用于下一代百日咳疫苗的开发。

items.title_en: Exact monogamy of steering and remote Wigner negativity for multimode Gaussian nodes
items.title_zh: 多模高斯节点的 steering 与远程 Wigner 负性的精确一夫一妻关系
items.abstract_en: Optical quantum networks route correlations through nodes that hold several modes and are linked to many neighbors. Steering is the correlation behind one-sided device-independent tasks and behind the remote preparation of non-Gaussian states. It is monogamous for a single mode, which can be steered by only one party, but how many neighbors can steer a node with $k$ modes was not known. We show that for Gaussian states the answer is exactly $2k-1$ when the neighbors use Gaussian measurements, with any number of measurement settings. The limit follows from a simple bound. To every neighbor we assign a share, computed from the covariance matrix, and we prove that the shares of all neighbors add up to at most $k$, irrespective of the amount of squeezing, amplification or noise the network contains. A neighbor steers the node by Gaussian measurements exactly when its share exceeds one half, and a network built from a harmonic tight frame reaches the limit. The same number governs remote Wigner negativity. A heralded non-Gaussian operation at the node can make at most $2k-1$ neighbors Wigner negative, and in our network a single heralded projection makes all of them negative in the same run. With $n$ settings of arbitrary measurements, at most $nk-1$ neighbors can steer the node or violate a Bell inequality with it. More than $2k-1$ neighbors can therefore steer the node or violate a Bell inequality with it only if they use non-Gaussian measurements with at least three settings, whereas entanglement can reach any number of neighbors. These results determine exactly how many neighbors one multimode node can serve with steering and with remote Wigner negativity.
items.abstract_zh: 光学量子网络通过拥有多个模式并与许多邻居相连的节点来路由关联。Steering 是一侧设备无关任务以及非高斯态远程制备背后的关联。对单个模式而言它是一夫一妻的（只能被一方 steering），但有多少邻居能够 steering 一个具有 k 个模式的节点此前并不清楚。我们证明，对于高斯态，当邻居使用高斯测量时（无论测量设置数目多少），答案恰好是 2k−1。该上限源自一个简单的界。我们给每个邻居分配一个由协方差矩阵计算的份额，并证明所有邻居的份额之和至多为 k，与网络所含的压缩、放大或噪声多少无关。一个邻居当且仅当其份额超过一半时，才能通过高斯测量 steering 该节点；由调和紧框架构建的网络可达到该极限。同一个数目也支配着远程 Wigner 负性。节点处的预示（heralded）非高斯操作最多能使 2k−1 个邻居呈 Wigner 负性，而在我们的网络中，一次预示投影就能在同一次运行中使所有这些邻居变为负性。使用 n 组任意测量的设置时，最多 nk−1 个邻居能够 steering 该节点或与之违反 Bell 不等式。因此，只有当邻居使用至少三种设置的非高斯测量时，超过 2k−1 个邻居才能 steering 该节点或与之违反 Bell 不等式；而纠缠则可以达到任意多个邻居。这些结果精确确定了单个多模节点在 steering 和远程 Wigner 负性方面能够服务多少个邻居。

items.title_en: Cell-Type-Specific Expression Is Hard to Predict from Bulk, but It Is Still Useful
items.title_zh: 细胞类型特异性表达难以从 bulk 数据预测，但仍然有用
items.abstract_en: Single-cell-informed deconvolution provides cell-type-resolved features for clinical bulk RNA cohorts. Most existing methods predict the proportions $π_k$ of the $K$ constituent cell types (CTs). Fewer predict cell-type-specific expression (CTSE) $μ_{kg}$ of gene $g$ in CT $k$, which can capture cell states that proportions miss, but recent benchmarks find it much harder. We explain this gap with closed-form accuracy bounds. For CTSE, we derive an $R^2$ ceiling for per-gene linear estimators. For proportions, the best linear estimator, which pools evidence across genes, has a closed-form $R^2$, and a computable lower bound on it predicts which CTs are learnable. We study targeted deconvolution of 106 biologically curated (CT, gene) pairs, found post hoc to have higher learnability scores. On overall survival in non-small cell lung cancer, estimation difficulty does not predict prognostic value across these targets. Yet a sparse survival model on deconvolved features, mostly CTSE, predicts survival as well as a sparse model on the bulk genes themselves, while attributing its signal to specific cell types. Some deconvolved CTSE features reveal prognostic signal not seen in the corresponding bulk gene.
items.abstract_zh: 由单细胞信息指导的去卷积为临床 bulk RNA 队列提供细胞类型分辨的特征。现有大多数方法预测 K 个组成细胞类型（CT）的比例 π_k。较少方法预测细胞类型 k 中基因 g 的细胞类型特异性表达（CTSE）μ_kg，它可以捕捉比例所遗漏的细胞状态，但近期基准测试发现其难度大得多。我们用闭式精度界来解释这一差距。对 CTSE，我们推导出逐基因线性估计器的 R² 上限。对比例而言，跨基因汇集证据的最佳线性估计器具有闭式 R²，其上可计算的下界可预测哪些 CT 是可学习的。我们研究了 106 个经生物学策展的（CT，基因）对的靶向去卷积，这些靶标在事后被发现具有更高的可学习性得分。在非小细胞肺癌的总生存期上，估计难度并不能预测这些靶标中的预后价值。然而，基于去卷积特征（多为 CTSE）的稀疏生存模型，其预后预测效果与基于 bulk 基因本身的稀疏模型相当，同时能将信号归因于特定细胞类型。某些去卷积 CTSE 特征揭示了相应 bulk 基因中未见到的预后信号。

items.title_en: Teaching a Multilingual Translation Model Regional Varieties: Castilian and Latin American Spanish, Asturian, Aragonese and Aranese with MADLAD-400-3B-MT
items.title_zh: 用 MADLAD-400-3B-MT 教多语言翻译模型地区变体：卡斯蒂利亚西班牙语与拉丁美洲西班牙语、阿斯图里亚斯语、阿拉贡语和阿拉内斯语
items.abstract_en: Massively multilingual translation models usually have one tag per language and no control over regional varieties, and they cover a region's smaller languages poorly or not at all. We report three fine-tunes of MADLAD-400-3B-MT, each adding target tags with low-rank adaptation (LoRA), back-translation of monolingual text and replay of the base model's own translations: for Spanish as written in Spain, for Latin American Spanish, and one model for three Romance languages of the Iberian Peninsula, Asturian ( ), Aragonese ( ) and Aranese ( ). For the Spanish varieties we annotate the 250.9M documents of MADLAD-400's Spanish split with a domain-supervised Spain vs. Latin America classifier and select variety text with a rule that admitted no Latin American document in a 340-document reference set. The Castilian model chooses Spain's everyday vocabulary in 97% of a targeted test (base model 62%) and vosotros for informal plural address in 70% (10%), while improving chrF++ on human references. A first finding is tag collapse: with a new tag initialised from , the parent tag drifts to the new variety (84-87% identical outputs). In the Iberian model, contrastive pairs and a separate learning rate for the tag embeddings keep each tag in its own language. Trained only on publicly available data, mostly the TAN-IBE Wikipedia corpora, the Iberian model matches or beats the TAN-IBE Marian systems in four of six Spanish directions on FLORES+, is 1.9 BLEU behind in Spanish->Aranese, and is second only to SalamandraTA-7B in most directions. The exception, Spanish->Aragonese, reflects a difference of written variety between Aragonese Wikipedia and the FLORES+ reference, not model quality. All three fine-tunes lose 0.6-0.7 chrF++ on average in thirteen other FLORES-200 directions. We release the models, data and variety classifier under open licences
items.abstract_zh: 大规模多语言翻译模型通常每种语言只有一个标签，且无法控制地区变体，对某一地区的小语种覆盖很差或完全不覆盖。我们报告对 MADLAD-400-3B-MT 的三次微调，每次均通过低秩适配（LoRA）加入目标标签、对单语文本进行回译，并重放基础模型自身的译文：分别针对西班牙本土书写的西班牙语、拉丁美洲西班牙语，以及一个覆盖伊比利亚半岛三种罗曼语（阿斯图里亚斯语（ ）、阿拉贡语（ ）和阿拉内斯语（ ））的模型。对于西班牙语变体，我们用领域监督的“西班牙 vs. 拉丁美洲”分类器为 MADLAD-400 西班牙语分片的 250.9M 篇文档打标注，并用一条在一个 340 篇文档的参考集中未纳入任何拉丁美洲文档的规则来选取变体文本。卡斯蒂利亚模型在针对性测试的 97% 中选择西班牙日常词汇（基础模型为 62%），在非正式复数称呼中有 70% 使用 vosotros（基础模型为 10%），同时在人工参考上提升了 chrF++。第一个发现是标签坍塌：当新标签由原标签初始化时，父标签会漂移到新变体（84–87% 的输出相同）。在伊比利亚模型中，对比对以及为标签嵌入设置单独学习率使每个标签保持在其自身语言中。伊比利亚模型仅使用公开可用数据（主要是 TAN-IBE 维基百科语料）训练，在 FLORES+ 的六个西班牙语方向中有四个达到或超过 TAN-IBE Marian 系统，在西班牙语→阿拉内斯语上落后 1.9 BLEU，在多数方向上仅次于 SalamandraTA-7B。例外是西班牙语→阿拉贡语，这反映的是阿拉贡语维基百科与 FLORES+ 参考之间书面变体的差异，而非模型质量。三个微调模型在另外十三个 FLORES-200 方向上平均损失 0.6–0.7 chrF++。我们以开放许可发布模型、数据和变体分类器。

items.title_en: MRCT: An Object-Centric Two-Layer Control Architecture for Heavy-Payload Multi-Robot Transportation
items.title_zh: MRCT：一种面向重载多机器人运输的以物体为中心的两层控制架构
items.abstract_en: Cooperative transportation of heavy payloads by heterogeneous mobile manipulators requires coordinated payload motion, force distribution, and compliant physical interaction. This paper presents MRCT, an object-centric two-layer control architecture for multi-robot transportation. At the object level, a model predictive controller (MPC) generates a coordinated contact-force reference for the payload. At the robot level, whole- body impedance control (WBIC) modules on individual robots realise the reference through a confidence-based blending of velocity-tracking and impedance torques. The blending mechanism emphasises tracking when the joint-velocity error is small and increases compliance when tracking degrades because of abrupt reference changes or physical disturbances. Simulation and hardware experiments with a heterogeneous team comprising a single-arm and a dual-arm mobile manipulator transporting a near-rated table payload demonstrate accurate object tracking, regulated contact forces, and stable payload orientation. Parameter sensitivity studies, obstacle-avoidance transportation, and step-load disturbance experiments further demonstrate the effectiveness of MRCT for reliable cooperative transportation under the evaluated conditions
items.abstract_zh: 由异构移动操作机器人协同运输重载物体，需要协调的负载运动、力分配以及柔顺的物理交互。本文提出 MRCT，一种面向多机器人运输的以物体为中心的两层控制架构。在物体层，模型预测控制器（MPC）为负载生成协调的接触力参考。在机器人层，各机器人上的全身阻抗控制（WBIC）模块通过基于置信度的速度跟踪力矩与阻抗力矩混合来实现该参考。该混合机制在关节速度误差较小时强调跟踪，而在因参考突变或物理扰动导致跟踪退化时提高柔顺性。使用由单臂和双臂移动操作机器人组成的异构团队运输接近额定负载的桌面物体的仿真与硬件实验表明，物体跟踪准确、接触力得到调节、负载姿态稳定。参数敏感性研究、避障运输和阶跃负载扰动实验进一步表明，MRCT 在所评估条件下对可靠协同运输是有效的。

items.title_en: AIRIS: Benchmarking Social Embodied Intelligence in Egocentric Streaming Videos
items.title_zh: AIRIS：在以自我为中心的流式视频中基准测试社会具身智能
items.abstract_en: Embodied agents operating around people must not only recognize social cues, but also decide when the available evidence is sufficient, whether to intervene, and how to respond without violating social norms. Existing benchmarks typically evaluate these abilities in isolation or with access to completed videos, obscuring where an online social decision fails. We introduce AIRIS, a causal streaming benchmark that formulates social embodied intelligence as a time-anchored chain of Attention, Intention, Reaction, and Interaction (A-I-R-I). AIRIS contains 8,000 expert-curated questions grounded in 357 egocentric clips across 11 context categories and 36 capability dimensions. At each query, models receive only the observation prefix available at that time; decision-aware metrics reward calibrated waiting and complete reactions while penalizing premature commitment. Evaluating 45 proprietary and open-source general-purpose, embodied, streaming-video, and omni-modal models reveals fragmented and temporally miscalibrated competence. General-purpose VLMs excel at passive cue grounding and intent recognition, whereas embodied specialists lead on isolated reaction sub-decisions; yet across all families, models frequently guess intents before sufficient evidence emerges and fail to jointly align intervention timing, action domain, and concrete execution within the same episode. AIRIS thus provides a diagnostic foundation for bridging the gap between passive social perception and reliable embodied interaction.
items.abstract_zh: 在人类周围运行的具身智能体不仅必须识别社会线索，还必须判断现有证据何时充分、是否应介入，以及如何在不违反社会规范的情况下作出回应。现有基准通常孤立地评估这些能力，或让模型访问已完成的视频，从而掩盖了在线社会决策在何处失败。我们提出 AIRIS，一个因果流式基准，将社会具身智能形式化为由注意、意图、反应和交互（A-I-R-I）组成的时间锚定链条。AIRIS 包含 8,000 个由专家策划的问题，基于 357 个第一人称视频片段，涵盖 11 个上下文类别和 36 个能力维度。在每次查询时，模型仅接收该时刻可用的观测前缀；决策感知指标奖励经过校准的等待和完整反应，同时惩罚过早承诺。评估 45 个专有和开源的通用、具身、流式视频以及全模态模型，揭示了碎片化且时间校准失当的能力。通用视觉语言模型擅长被动线索定位和意图识别，而具身专家模型在孤立的反应子决策上领先；然而在所有模型家族中，模型常常在充分证据出现之前猜测意图，并且未能在同一片段内联合对齐干预时机、动作域和具体执行。因此，AIRIS 为弥合被动社会感知与可靠具身交互之间的差距提供了诊断基础。
